                 (c)     In the event and on each occasion that any Net Proceeds (excluding any Specified
Asset Sale Proceeds and any Net Proceeds that the Lead Borrower intends to designate as Specified Asset
Sale Proceeds) are received by or on behalf of the Lead Borrower or any other Loan Party in respect of any
Prepayment Event, within ten (10) Business Days (such longer period as agreed between the Lead Borrower
and the Term Loan Administrative Agent) after receipt of such Net Proceeds, the applicable Borrower shall
make an offer to prepay the Initial Term Loans as follows (in each case, giving effect to the provisions of
Section 2.11(f) and (g) (below)):

                                 (i)      in the case of a Prepayment Event described in clause (a) of the
      definition thereof, in an aggregate amount equal to the Asset Sale Prepayment Percentage of such
      Net Proceeds; provided that, with respect to this clause (i), if the Lead Borrower or any other Group
      Member invests (or commits to invest) an amount equal to the Net Proceeds from such Prepayment
      Event (or a portion thereof) within 18 months after receipt of such Net Proceeds by the Lead Borrower
      or such other Group Member (including pursuant to any Permitted Acquisition, Capital Expenditures,
      Capitalized Software Expenditures or acquisitions of IP Rights, repayment of intercompany loans
      among the Lead Borrower and/or the other Group Members, acquisition of Intellectual Property
      and/or other Investments permitted under Section 6.04), then, at the option of the Lead Borrower, no
      offer to prepay shall be required pursuant to this clause (i) in respect of such Net Proceeds in respect
      of such Prepayment Event (or the applicable portion of such Net Proceeds, if applicable) except to
      the extent of any such Net Proceeds therefrom that have not been so invested (or committed to be
      invested) by the end of such 18-month period (or if committed to be so invested within such 18-
      month period, have not been so invested within 6 months after the end of the 18-month period), at
      which time an offer to prepay shall be required in an amount equal to the amount of such Net Proceeds
      that has not been so invested (or committed to be invested); provided, further that (I) the Lead
      Borrower may elect to deem expenditures that otherwise would be permissible investments that occur
      prior to receipt of the Net Proceeds from such Prepayment Event to have been invested in accordance
      with the provisions hereof (it being agreed that such deemed expenditure shall have been made no
      earlier than the earliest of (A) notice of such intended Prepayment Event, (B) execution of a definitive
      agreement for such Prepayment Event (if applicable) and (C) the occurrence of such Prepayment
      Event) and (II) pending the final application of any such Net Proceeds pursuant to this clause (i), the
      Lead Borrower or the applicable Group Member may elect to apply such Net Proceeds temporarily
      to reduce Indebtedness outstanding under the ABL Facility or any revolving credit facility (other than


      the Last-Out Facility or a Permitted Sponsor Debt facility) or otherwise invest such Net Proceeds in
      any manner not prohibited by this Agreement; and

                                (ii)    in the case of a Prepayment Event described in clause (b) of the
      definition thereof, in an aggregate amount equal to 100% of the amount of such Net Proceeds;

provided that, the Borrowers may use a portion of such Net Proceeds to prepay, repurchase or make an
offer to prepay any other Indebtedness that is secured by the Collateral (in whole or in part) on a pari passu
basis with the Initial Term Loans (without regard to the control of remedies) to the extent such other
Indebtedness and the Liens securing such other Indebtedness are permitted hereunder and the
documentation governing such other Indebtedness requires such a prepayment or repurchase (or offer to
prepay or repurchase) thereof with the proceeds of such Prepayment Event (excluding, with respect to any
Net Proceeds of sales of Term Priority Collateral, the ABL Facility) (such Indebtedness required to be so
prepaid or repurchased or offered to be so prepaid or repurchased under the applicable circumstances,
“Other Applicable Indebtedness”), in each case in an amount not to exceed the product of (x) the amount
of such Net Proceeds and (y) a fraction, the numerator of which is the outstanding principal amount of such
Other Applicable Indebtedness and the denominator of which is the aggregate outstanding principal amount
of Term Loans and such Other Applicable Indebtedness, and such amount so used shall reduce, on a dollar-
for-dollar basis, any prepayment amount due hereunder in respect of such Net Proceeds. Each prepayment
or offer to prepay pursuant to this paragraph shall be made on or before the date that is ten Business Days
after the receipt of the applicable Net Proceeds (or on the Business Day immediately following the date of
expiration of the applicable investment period, as applicable).

                 (d)      Following the end of any fiscal year, commencing with the first full fiscal year
ending after the Closing Date (the “Excess Cash Flow Period”), within ten (10) Business Days (such longer
period as agreed between the Lead Borrower and the Term Loan Administrative Agent), the Lead Borrower
shall make an offer to prepay Initial Term Loans in an aggregate amount equal to the ECF Percentage (after
giving effect to any adjustment pursuant to the Permitted ECF Recalculation Considerations (as defined
below)) of Excess Cash Flow for such fiscal year (in each case, giving effect to the provisions of Section
2.11(f) and (g) (below)); provided that such amount shall be reduced, at the option of the Lead Borrower,
by the aggregate amount (other than any amount applied to reduce the prepayment required under this
clause (d) in respect of any prior year) of:

                               (i)     voluntary prepayments or repurchases of (i) Term Loans (and, to the
      extent accompanied by corresponding permanent reductions of commitments under the ABL Facility

      committed during such fiscal year or, at the option of the Lead Borrower, after such fiscal year and

      of prepayments pursuant to Section 2.11(a)(ii) or similar provisions or repurchases shall be limited
      to the actual amount of such cash prepayment or repurchases),

                                (ii)     voluntary prepayments or repurchases of Indebtedness secured on a
      pari passu or senior basis (in whole or in part) with the Term Loans (without regard to the control of

      prepayment is due as provided below (provided that such reduction as a result of prepayments


pursuant to Section 2.11(a)(ii) or similar provisions or pursuant to repurchases shall be limited to the
actual amount of such cash prepayment or repurchases),

                         (iii)   except to the extent deducted in the calculation of Excess Cash
Flow, the amount of any reduction in the outstanding amount of any Term Loans, Incremental
Equivalent/Ratio Debt, Permitted First Priority Refinancing Debt or other Indebtedness secured on a
pari passu or senior basis (in whole or in part) with the Term Loans (without regard to the control of

year (including in connection with any “Dutch auction”) (with respect to Term Loans) and any
equivalent provisions with respect to any Incremental Equivalent/Ratio Debt, Permitted First Priority
Refinancing Debt and/or such other Indebtedness (or, in each case, at the option of the Lead
Borrower, after such fiscal year and prior to the time such offer to prepay is due as provided below)
(provided that such reduction shall be limited to the actual amount of Indebtedness subject to the
relevant assignment),

                         (iv)    voluntary prepayments of loans under the ABL Facility, to the
extent such loans were originally made on the Closing Date to account for additional upfront fees or

                         (v)     to the extent accompanied by permanent reduction of commitments,
optional reductions of commitments under the ABL Facility or other revolving commitments, other
than to the extent any such prepayment is funded with the proceeds of Funded Debt,

Software Expenditures, New Projects and all cash payments made to acquire IP Rights,

of Swap Agreements,

expenditures), New Projects and Permitted Acquisitions or other Investments (including purchase

due as provided below (or committed or, in the case of Capital Expenditures (or similar expenditures)
and New Projects, budgeted) during such period to be used for such purposes within the succeeding
12 month period, in each case subject to reversal of such deduction if any such committed or budgeted
amount is not actually expended within such 12 month period; and

Restricted Debt Payments, in each case, during such fiscal year or, at the option of the Lead Borrower,

(A) non-cash Restricted Debt Payments and (B) Restricted Debt Payments made pursuant to Section
6.08(b)(ii), (iii)(1) and (vii),

  in each case, except to the extent funded with the proceeds of long-term Indebtedness (other than
  revolving Indebtedness) (any payments described in the foregoing clauses (i) through (ix) of this
  proviso that are made after the end of the applicable Excess Cash Flow Period but prior to the
  making of the applicable offer to prepay in respect of such Excess Cash Flow Period being referred
  to herein as an “After Year End Payment”);

  provided that:


                               (A)       an Excess Cash Flow payment pursuant to this clause (d) shall
only be required with respect to amounts in excess of the greater of (x) $63,125,000 and (y) 25% of

such excess amount shall be applied to the payment thereof);

option of the Lead Borrower, the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio shall be recalculated giving Pro Forma

Cash Flow shall be determined by reference to such recalculated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio (the

                                       (C)        an Excess Cash Flow payment amount shall, at the option of the
Lead Borrower, in each case without duplication of any such reduction from the definition of “Excess Cash
Flow” by such amounts, be reduced on a dollar-for-dollar basis for such fiscal year by the aggregate amount
of clauses (b)(ii), (vi), (vii), (viii), (ix), (xi), (xii) and (xiv) of the definition of “Excess Cash Flow” for such
fiscal year.

                 Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the foregoing, the Lead Borrower may use a
        portion of such amount of Excess Cash Flow (as so reduced) in respect of any such fiscal year that
        would otherwise be required to be applied to make an offer to prepay Term Loans to prepay or
        repurchase (or offer to prepay or repurchase) any Other Applicable Indebtedness to the extent such

        Indebtedness and the denominator of which is the aggregate outstanding principal amount of Term

                (e)      Upon the occurrence of a Change in Control, within fifteen (15) Business Days
(such longer period as agreed between the Lead Borrower and the Term Loan Administrative Agent) of
such event, the Lead Borrower shall make to each Initial Term Lender an offer to prepay the Initial Term
Loans in an amount equal to 100% of the outstanding principal of Initial Term Loans, together with accrued
and unpaid interest thereon to the date payment, but without premium or penalty;

                 (f)      Prior to any optional prepayment or, to the extent practicable, offer to prepay Loans
hereunder, the Lead Borrower shall select the Borrowing or Borrowings to be prepaid and shall specify
such selection in a written notice of such prepayment (the “Notice of Prepayment”) or offer to prepay (the
“Notice of Offer to Prepay”), as applicable, to the Term Loan Administrative Agent (or telephonic notice
promptly confirmed thereafter by delivery of a written notice) delivered in accordance with clause (g)
below. In the event of any offer to prepay Term Loans made at a time when more than one Class of Term


Loans remains outstanding, the Lead Borrower shall select Term Loans to be prepaid so that the aggregate
amount of such prepayment is allocated among Classes of Term Loans pro rata based on the aggregate
principal amount of outstanding borrowings of each such Class (or less than pro rata so long as the lenders
of such Class of loans to be prepaid on a less than pro rata basis agree (or shall have agreed) to such less
than pro rata amount); provided that, notwithstanding the foregoing, in the case of a Payment Deferral
Event, the Lead Borrower may, in its discretion, elect to instead apply amounts that would otherwise be
deferred or retained on account of such Payment Deferral Event to Term Loans that may at that time be
prepaid without giving rise to such Payment Deferral Event, on a greater than pro rata basis with respect to
any applicable Class. Notwithstanding the foregoing, a prepayment of (x) Term Loans with the proceeds of
Indebtedness incurred pursuant to Section 2.21 shall be applied to the Class of Term Loans being refinanced
pursuant thereto and (y) Term Loans with the proceeds of any Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness
issued to the extent permitted under Section 6.01(a) shall be applied to the Class of Term Loans being
refinanced pursuant thereto. Any Term Lender (and, to the extent provided in the Incremental Facility
Amendment, Refinancing Amendment or Loan Modification Offer for any Class of Other Term Loans, any
Term Lender that holds Other Term Loans of such Class) may elect, by written notice to the Term Loan
Administrative Agent at least one Business Day prior to the prepayment date, to decline all (but not a portion
of) any prepayment of its Term Loans or Other Term Loans of any such Class pursuant to this Section 2.11
(other than an optional prepayment pursuant to Section 2.11(a) or an offer to prepay resulting from a
Prepayment Event pursuant to clause (b) of the definition thereof solely to the extent such offer to prepay
is with proceeds of Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness or otherwise represents a refinancing of
such Term Loans, which may not be declined), in which case the aggregate amount of the prepayment that
would have been so applied but was so declined (such amounts, the “Declined Proceeds”) shall be retained
by the Borrowers (such amounts, “Retained Declined Proceeds”). Any prepayment of a Term Loan of any
Class (i) pursuant to Section 2.11(a) shall be applied to reduce the subsequent scheduled and outstanding
repayments of the Term Loans of such Class to be made pursuant to Section 2.10 as directed by the Lead
Borrower (and absent such direction in direct order of maturity) and (ii) pursuant to Section 2.11(a)(ii),
Section 2.11(c) or Section 2.11(d) shall be applied to reduce the subsequent scheduled and outstanding
repayments of the Term Loans of such Class to be made pursuant to Section 2.10, or, except as otherwise
provided in any Incremental Facility Amendment, Refinancing Amendment or Loan Modification Offer,
pursuant to the corresponding section of such Incremental Facility Amendment, Refinancing Amendment
or Loan Modification Offer, as applicable, as directed by the Lead Borrower (and absent such direction in
direct order of maturity). Optional prepayments of Term Loans shall be allocated among the Classes of
Term Loans as directed by the Lead Borrower.

                (g)

                              (i)    The Borrower shall notify the Term Loan Administrative Agent of
      any optional prepayment pursuant to Section 2.11(a) by delivering a Notice of Prepayment to the
      Term Loan Administrative Agent(i) in the case of prepayment of a Term Benchmark Borrowing, not
      later than 2:00 p.m., Local Time, three Business Days before the date of prepayment or (ii) in the
      case of prepayment of an ABR Borrowing, not later than 12:00 p.m., Local Time, on the date of
      prepayment (or, in each case of the foregoing clauses (i) and (ii), such shorter period as agreed
      between the Lead Borrower and the Term Loan Administrative Agent).

                               (ii)    Within the timeframes specified in, as applicable, Section 2.11(c),
      Section 2.11(d) or Section 2.11(e), the Lead Borrower shall notify the Term Loan Administrative
      Agent of any offer to prepay pursuant to Section 2.11(c), Section 2.11(d) or Section 2.11(e) by
      delivering a Notice of Offer to Prepay to the Term Loan Administrative Agent, respectively, on the
      date (each an “Offer Settlement Date”) that is twenty (20) Business Days after the date of the Notice
      of Offer to Prepay. Each Term Lender wishing to accept such offer to prepay shall reply in writing
      indicating whether such offer to prepay is accepted in whole or in part (and if so, to what extent) by


2:00 p.m., Local Time on the fifth (5th) Business Day immediately preceding the Offer Settlement
Date. Two (2) Business Days prior to any Offer Settlement Date, the Lead Borrower shall deliver to
each Term Lender that has accepted an offer to prepay a notice specifying the principal amount of
the Term Loans of such Term Lender to be prepaid on such Offer Settlement Date and the amount of
accrued and unpaid interest thereon to but excluding the Offer Settlement Date. On each Offer
Settlement Date, Borrower shall pay to those Term Lenders who have accepted the related offer to
prepay the aggregate amount to be paid pursuant to Section 2.11(c), Section 2.11(d) and Section
2.11(e).

                           (iii)    Each such notice shall be irrevocable and shall specify the
prepayment date and the principal amount of each Borrowing or portion thereof to be prepaid and, in
the case of any offer to prepay, a reasonably detailed calculation of the amount of such prepayment;
provided that a notice of prepayment may state that such notice is conditioned upon the effectiveness
of other credit facilities or the receipt of the proceeds from the issuance of other Indebtedness or the
occurrence of any other specified event or condition, in which case such Notice of Prepayment may
be revoked or its effectiveness deferred by the Lead Borrower (by notice to the Term Loan
Administrative Agent on or prior to the specified date of prepayment) if such condition is not
satisfied. Promptly following receipt of any such notice, the Term Loan Administrative Agent shall
advise the Term Lenders of the contents thereof. Each partial prepayment of any Borrowing shall be
in an amount that would be permitted in the case of an advance of a Borrowing of the same Type as
provided in Section 2.02, except as necessary to apply fully the required amount of a prepayment, or,
in the case of an optional prepayment required to be allocated among multiple Classes (as set forth
in Section 2.11(f)). Each prepayment of a Borrowing shall be applied ratably to the Loans included
in the prepaid Borrowing. Prepayments shall be accompanied by accrued interest to the extent
required by Section 2.13; provided that the amount of accrued interest so owing may, at the option of
the Lead Borrower, be netted in the calculation of the principal amount of the Loans that is required
to be prepaid, whereby the amount of the applicable principal prepayment and the amount of such
interest shall be determined by the Lead Borrower in good faith. At the Lead Borrower’s election in
connection with any prepayment pursuant to this Section 2.11, such prepayment shall not be applied
to any Term Loan of a Defaulting Lender and shall be allocated ratably among the relevant non-
Defaulting Lenders.

                                (iv)     to the extent that and for so long as the Lead Borrower has
      determined in good faith that repatriation of any or all the Net Proceeds of any Foreign Prepayment
      Event or Excess Cash Flow would give rise to a risk of liability for the directors of any Foreign
      Subsidiary (other than any Canadian Loan Party), the Net Proceeds or Excess Cash Flow so affected
      will not be required to be taken into account in determining the amount to be applied to repay Term
      Loans at the times provided in Section 2.11(c) or Section 2.11(d), as the case may be, and such
      amounts may be retained by such Subsidiary. For all purposes of this Agreement, any of the foregoing
      prohibitions, violations, legal liability events, fiduciary duty or similar considerations imposed by
      applicable law, rule or regulation, capitalization requirements imposed by applicable law, rule or
      regulation and/or Tax costs or consequences, in each case as set forth above in this clause (h), are
      referred to collectively as “Payment Deferral Events”.

        It is understood and agreed that if any amount that is permitted to be retained on account of any
Payment Deferral Event is instead applied pursuant to Section 2.11(f) to prepay any Class of Term Loans
that may be prepaid without giving rise to such Payment Deferral Event, the relevant Restricted Subsidiary
shall have no obligation to repatriate or otherwise make any prepayment with respect to the amount so
applied pursuant to Section 2.11(f).

        Section 2.12     Fees.

                (a)     The Borrowers agree to pay to the Term Loan Administrative Agent, for its own
account, fees payable in the amounts and at the times separately agreed upon between the Lead Borrower
and the Term Loan Administrative Agent.

                (b)   All fees payable hereunder shall be paid on the dates due, in immediately available
funds, to the Term Loan Administrative Agent. Except as may be separately agreed between the Lead
Borrower and the Person entitled thereto, fees paid hereunder shall not be refundable under any
circumstances.

        Section 2.13     Interest.


                 (d)     Accrued interest on each Loan shall be payable in arrears on each Interest Payment
Date for such Loan; provided that (i) interest accrued pursuant to clause (c) of this Section 2.13 shall be
payable on demand, (ii) in the event of any repayment or prepayment of any Loan, accrued interest on the
principal amount repaid or prepaid shall be payable on the date of such repayment or prepayment and (iii) in
the event of any conversion of any Term Benchmark Loan prior to the end of the current Interest Period
therefor, accrued interest on such Loan shall be payable on the effective date of such conversion.

                  (e)     All computations of interest for ABR Loans shall be made on the basis of a year
of 365 or 366 days, as the case may be, and actual days elapsed. All other computations of fees and interest
shall be made on the basis of a 360-day year and actual days elapsed. Interest shall accrue on each Loan for
the day on which the Loan is made, and shall not accrue on a Loan, or any portion thereof, for the day on
which the Loan or such portion is paid; provided that any Loan that is repaid on the same day on which it
is made shall bear interest for one day. Each determination by the Term Loan Administrative Agent of an
interest rate or fee hereunder shall be conclusive and binding for all purposes, absent manifest error.

                     (f)       For the purposes of the Interest Act (Canada) and disclosure thereunder, (i)
whenever a rate of interest or fee rate hereunder is calculated on the basis of a year (the “deemed year”)
that contains fewer days than the actual number of days in the calendar year of calculation, such rate of
interest or fee rate shall be expressed as a yearly rate by multiplying such rate of interest or fee rate by the
actual number of days in the calendar year of calculation and dividing it by the number of days in the deemed
year, (ii) the principle of deemed reinvestment of interest shall not apply to any interest calculation hereunder and
(iii) the rates of interest stipulated herein are intended to be nominal rates and not effective rates or yields. .

                (g)      Each of the Canadian Loan Parties confirms that it fully understands and is able to
calculate the rate of interest applicable to the Credit Facilities under this Agreement based on the
methodology for calculating per annum rates provided for in this Agreement. The Term Loan
Administrative Agent agrees that if requested in writing by the Canadian Borrower it will calculate the
nominal and effective per annum rate of interest on any Borrowing outstanding at the time of such request
and provide such information to the Canadian Borrower promptly following such request; provided that
any error in any such calculation, or any failure to provide such information on request, shall not relieve
the Canadian Borrower or any other Canadian Loan Party of any of its obligations under this Agreement or
any other Loan Document, nor result in any liability to the Term Loan Administrative Agent or any Term
Lender. Each Canadian Loan Party hereby irrevocably agrees not to plead or assert, whether by way of
defense or otherwise, in any proceeding relating to the Loan Documents, that the interest payable under the
Loan Documents and the calculation thereof has not been adequately disclosed to the Canadian Loan
Parties, whether pursuant to section 4 of the Interest Act (Canada) or any other applicable law or legal
principle.

                 (h)      Any provision of this Agreement that would oblige a Canadian Loan Party to pay
any fine, penalty or rate of interest on any arrears of principal or interest secured by a mortgage on real
property or hypothec on immovables that has the effect of increasing the charge on arrears beyond the rate
of interest payable on principal money not in arrears shall not apply to such Canadian Loan Party, which
shall be required to pay interest on money in arrears at the same rate of interest payable on principal money
not in arrears.


                  (i)      If any provision of this Agreement would oblige the Canadian Borrower or any
other Canadian Loan Party to make any payment of interest or other amount payable to any Term Lender
in an amount or calculated at a rate which would be prohibited by applicable Requirements of Law or would
result in a receipt by that Term Lender of “interest” at a “criminal rate” (as such terms are construed under
the Criminal Code (Canada)), then, notwithstanding such provision, such amount or rate shall be deemed
to have been adjusted with retroactive effect to the maximum amount or rate of interest, as the case may
be, as would not be so prohibited by applicable Requirements of Law or so result in a receipt by that Term
Lender of “interest” at a “criminal rate”; and to the extent that any excess has been charged or received, the
Lender shall apply such excess against the outstanding Term Loans and refund any further excess amount.

        Section 2.14     [Reserved].

        Section 2.15     Increased Costs.

                (a)      If any Change in Law shall:

                               (i)      [reserved];

                                (ii)   impose, modify or deem applicable any reserve, special deposit,
      compulsory loan, insurance charge or similar requirement against assets of, deposits with or for the
      account of, or credit extended by any Term Lender (except any such reserve requirement reflected in
      the relevant Adjusted Term SOFR); or

                                (iii)  impose on any Term Lender or the Canadian interbank market any
      other condition, cost or expense (other than with respect to Taxes) affecting this Agreement or Term
      Benchmark Loans made by such Term Lender or participation therein;

and the result of any of the foregoing shall be to increase the cost to the Term Loan Administrative Agent
or such Term Lender of making or maintaining any Term Benchmark Loan (or of maintaining its obligation
to make any such Loan or of observing or performing its obligations under any Loan Document) or to
increase the cost to the Term Loan Administrative Agent or such Term Lender of participating in, or to
reduce the amount of any sum received or receivable by the Term Loan Administrative Agent or such Term
Lender hereunder (whether of principal, interest or otherwise), in each case in an amount deemed by such
affected Person to be material, then, from time to time upon request of the Term Loan Administrative Agent
or such Term Lender contemplated by clause (c) below, the applicable Borrower will pay (or cause to be
paid) to the Term Loan Administrative Agent or such Term Lender, as the case may be, such additional
amount or amounts as will compensate the Term Loan Administrative Agent or such Term Lender, as the
case may be, for such increased costs actually incurred or reduction actually suffered, provided that the
Borrowers shall not be liable for such compensation if (x) the relevant Change in Law is publicly announced
or occurs on or prior to the date such Term Lender becomes a party hereto, (y) such Term Lender invokes
Section 2.23 or (z) in the case of requests for reimbursement under clause (ii) above resulting from a market
disruption, (A) the relevant circumstances are not generally affecting the banking market or (B) the
applicable request has not been made by Term Lenders constituting Required Lenders; provided, further,
that to the extent any such costs or reductions are incurred by any Term Lender as a result of any requests,
rules, guidelines or directives enacted or promulgated under the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and
Consumer Protection Act of 2010 or Basel III, then such Term Lender shall be compensated pursuant to
this Section 2.15(a) only to the extent such Term Lender is imposing such charges on similarly situated
borrowers where the terms of other syndicated credit facilities permit it to impose such charges.
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, neither the Term Loan Administrative Agent
nor any Term Lender shall be entitled to request any payment or amount under this Section 2.15 unless the
Term Loan Administrative Agent or such Term Lender is generally demanding payment (and certifies to


the Lead Borrower and each other Loan Party that it is generally demanding payment) under comparable
provisions of its agreements with similarly situated borrowers of similar credit quality.

                  (b)     If any Term Lender determines that any Change in Law regarding capital or
liquidity requirements has the effect of reducing the rate of return on such Term Lender’s capital or on the
capital of such Term Lender’s holding company, if any, as a consequence of this Agreement or the Loans
made by such Term Lender, to a level below that which such Term Lender or such Term Lender’s holding
company could have achieved but for such Change in Law (taking into consideration such Term Lender’s
policies and the policies of such Term Lender’s holding company with respect to capital adequacy and
liquidity), then, from time to time upon request of such Term Lender contemplated by clause (c) below, the
Borrowers will pay or cause to be paid to such Term Lender, such additional amount or amounts as will
compensate such Term Lender or such Term Lender’s holding company for any such reduction actually
suffered.

                 (c)      Any Term Lender requesting compensation under this Section 2.15 shall be
required to deliver a certificate to the Lead Borrower, (i) setting forth the amount or amounts necessary to
compensate such Term Lender or its holding company in reasonable detail, as the case may be, as specified
in clause (a) or (b) of this Section 2.15, (ii) setting forth, in reasonable detail, the manner in which such
amount or amounts were determined and (iii) certifying that such Term Lender is generally charging such
amounts to similarly situated borrowers, which certificate shall be conclusive absent manifest error. The
Borrower shall pay such Term Lender the amount shown as due on any such certificate within 30 days after
receipt thereof.

                  (d)      Failure or delay on the part of any Term Lender to demand compensation pursuant
to this Section 2.15 shall not constitute a waiver of such Term Lender’s right to demand such compensation;
provided that the Borrowers shall not be required to compensate a Term Lender pursuant to this Section
2.15 for any increased costs incurred or reductions suffered more than 180 days prior to the date that such
Term Lender, as the case may be, notifies the Lead Borrower of the Change in Law giving rise to such
increased costs or reductions and of such Term Lender’s intention to claim compensation therefor;
provided, further, that, if the Change in Law giving rise to such increased costs or reductions is retroactive,
then the 180-day period referred to above shall be extended to include the period of retroactive effect
thereof.

               (e)     For the avoidance of doubt, this Section 2.15 shall not apply to Taxes, which shall
be governed exclusively by Section 2.17.

         Section 2.16     Break Funding Payments. In the event of (a) the payment of any principal of any
Term Benchmark Loan other than on the last day of an Interest Period applicable thereto (including as a
result of an Event of Default), (b) the conversion of any Term Benchmark Loan other than on the last day
of the Interest Period applicable thereto, (c) the failure to borrow, convert, continue or prepay any Term
Benchmark Loan on the date specified in any notice delivered pursuant hereto (regardless of whether such
notice may be revoked under Section 2.11(g) and is revoked in accordance therewith) or (d) the assignment
of any Term Benchmark Loan other than on the last day of the Interest Period applicable thereto as a result
of a request by the Lead Borrower pursuant to Section 2.19 or Section 9.02(c), then, in any such event, the
Borrowers shall, after receipt of a written request by any Term Lender affected by any such event (which
request shall set forth in reasonable detail the basis for requesting such amount), compensate such Term
Lender for the actual and documented loss, cost and expense incurred by such Term Lender attributable to
such event (other than loss of profit). Any Term Lender requesting compensation under this Section 2.16
shall be required to deliver a certificate to the Lead Borrower (i) setting forth any amount or amounts that
such Term Lender is entitled to receive pursuant to this Section 2.16, attaching the documentary support
therefor and, in reasonable detail, describing the manner in which such amount or amounts were determined


and (ii) certifying that such Term Lender is requesting reimbursement for the relevant amount from
similarly situated borrowers generally, which certificate shall be conclusive absent manifest error. The
Borrower shall pay such Term Lender the amount shown as due on any such certificate within 30 days after
receipt of such demand. Notwithstanding the foregoing, this Section 2.16 will not apply to losses, costs or
expenses resulting from (i) the revocation by the Lead Borrower of a Borrowing Request pursuant to
Section 2.26 or the occurrence of any Benchmark Transition Event and (ii) Taxes, as to which Section 2.17
shall govern.

        Section 2.17     Taxes.

                  (a)     Any and all payments by or on account of any obligation of any Loan Party under
any Loan Document shall be made free and clear of and without withholdings or deduction for any Taxes;
provided that if the applicable Withholding Agent shall be required by applicable Requirements of Law (as
determined in the good faith discretion of the applicable Withholding Agent) to withhold or deduct any
Taxes from such payments, then (i) the applicable Withholding Agent shall be entitled to make such
withholdings or deductions, (ii) the applicable Withholding Agent shall timely pay the full amount withheld
or deducted to the relevant Governmental Authority in accordance with applicable Requirements of Law
and (iii) if the Tax in question is an Indemnified Tax, the applicable Loan Party, as may be relevant, shall
pay such additional amount as necessary so that after such deductions have been made (including
withholdings or deductions applicable to additional amounts payable under this Section 2.17) the Term
Lender (or, in the case of a payment received by the Term Loan Administrative Agent for its own account,
the Term Loan Administrative Agent) receives an amount equal to the sum it would have received had no
such withholdings or deductions been made.

                (b)      [Reserved].

               (c)     Without limiting the provisions of Section 2.17(a) above (but without duplication
of any amounts paid or payable to such Section 2.17(a)), the Loan Parties shall timely pay to the relevant
Governmental Authority in accordance with Requirements of Law, or at the option of the Term Loan
Administrative Agent timely reimburse it for the payment of, any Other Taxes.

                  (d)     The Loan Parties shall indemnify the Term Loan Administrative Agent and each
Term Lender, within 30 days after written demand therefor, for the full amount of any Indemnified Taxes
payable or paid by, or required to be withheld or deducted from a payment to, the Term Loan Administrative
Agent or such Term Lender, as the case may be (including Indemnified Taxes imposed or asserted on or
attributable to amounts payable under this Section 2.17) and any reasonable and documented expenses
arising therefrom or with respect thereto (other than Indemnified Taxes and any expenses payable by reason
of the gross negligence, bad faith or willful misconduct of the applicable recipient), whether or not such
Indemnified Taxes were correctly or legally imposed or asserted by the relevant Governmental Authority;
provided, that if the Loan Parties reasonably believe that such Taxes were not correctly or legally asserted
by the relevant Governmental Authority, the Term Loan Administrative Agent, or Term Lender, as
applicable, will use reasonable efforts to cooperate with the Loan Parties to obtain a refund of such Taxes
(which shall be repaid to the Loan Parties in accordance with Section 2.17(f)) so long as such efforts would
not result in any additional out-of-pocket costs or expenses to the Term Loan Administrative Agent or Term
Lender as applicable, that are not reimbursed by the Loan Parties or be otherwise materially
disadvantageous to the Term Loan Administrative Agent or such Term Lender, as applicable; provided
further, that, the Loan Parties shall not be required to compensate the Term Loan Administrative Agent,
any Term Lender pursuant to this Section 2.17 for any amounts incurred in any fiscal year for which the
Term Loan Administrative Agent or such Term Lender does not furnish notice of such claim within 180
days from the end of such fiscal year; provided, further, that if the circumstances giving rise to such claim
have a retroactive effect (e.g., in connection with the audit of a prior Tax year), then the beginning of such


180 day period shall be extended to include such period of retroactive effect. A certificate setting forth in
reasonable detail the basis and calculation of the amount of such payment or liability delivered to the Lead
Borrower by a Term Lender (with a copy to the Term Loan Administrative Agent) or by the Term Loan
Administrative Agent on its own behalf or on behalf of a Term Lender, shall be conclusive absent manifest
error.

                 (e)     As soon as practicable after any payment of Indemnified Taxes by a Loan Party to
a Governmental Authority pursuant to this Section 2.17, such Loan Party shall deliver to the Term Loan
Administrative Agent the original or a certified copy of a receipt issued by such Governmental Authority
evidencing such payment, a copy of the return reporting such payment or other evidence of such payment
reasonably satisfactory to the Term Loan Administrative Agent.

                 (f)     Each Term Lender shall deliver to the Lead Borrower and the Term Loan
Administrative Agent at the time or times reasonably requested by the Lead Borrower or the Term Loan
Administrative Agent, such properly completed and executed documentation or information prescribed by
applicable Requirements of Law (or the interpretation or administration thereof) and such other
documentation or information reasonably requested by the Lead Borrower or the Term Loan Administrative
Agent (i) as will permit such payments to be made without, or at a reduced rate of, withholding or (ii) as
will enable the Lead Borrower or the Term Loan Administrative Agent to determine whether or not such
Term Lender is subject to backup withholding or information reporting requirements. Notwithstanding
anything to the contrary in the preceding sentence, the completion, execution and submission of such
documentation (other than such documentation set forth in Sections 2.17(f)(i)(1) through (3) below) shall
not be required if in the Term Lender’s reasonable judgment such completion, execution or submission
would subject such Term Lender to any material unreimbursed cost or expense or would materially
prejudice the legal or commercial position of such Term Lender. Each Term Lender shall, whenever a lapse
of time or change in circumstances renders such documentation or information obsolete, expired or
inaccurate in any respect, deliver promptly to the Lead Borrower and the Term Loan Administrative Agent
updated or other appropriate documentation or information (including any new documentation or
information reasonably requested by the Lead Borrower or the Term Loan Administrative Agent) or
promptly notify the Lead Borrower and the Term Loan Administrative Agent in writing of its legal inability
to do so. Each Term Lender hereby authorizes the Term Loan Administrative Agent to deliver to the Loan
Parties and to any successor Term Loan Administrative Agent any documentation provided by such Term
Lender to the Term Loan Administrative Agent pursuant to this Section 2.17.

or discharge of all obligations under any Loan Document, the expiration or termination of the Commitments
or the termination of this Agreement or any provision hereof.
