executed IRS forms (as specified under Section 2.17(f)) demonstrating that such Term Lender is fully
exempt from U.S. withholding tax on payments of interest with respect to such Loans hereunder. If such
Term Lender is not legally entitled to provide such IRS forms upon such request (except to the extent that
such Term Lender is not legally entitled to provide such documentation as a result of a change in applicable
law following the Closing Date), then (i) such Term Lender’s obligations under Section 2.19(a) shall apply
with respect to such Loans of such Term Lender, mutatis mutandis, with clause (x) of Section 2.19(a)
deemed satisfied if the assignment and delegation is made to another office, branch, or Affiliate that can
provide IRS Forms demonstrating such exemption, and (ii) the Lead Borrower shall be entitled, at its sole
expense and effort, upon notice to such Term Lender and the Term Loan Administrative Agent, to apply
the provisions of Section 2.19(b) with respect to such Loans of such Term Lender.


        Section 2.18      Payments Generally; Pro Rata Treatment; Sharing of Setoffs.

                  (a)     Unless otherwise specified, the Borrowers shall make each payment required to be
made by such Borrower under any Loan Document (whether of principal, interest, fees or of amounts
payable under Section 2.15, Section 2.16 or Section 2.17, or otherwise) prior to the time expressly required
hereunder or under such other Loan Document for such payment (or, if no such time is expressly required,
prior to 1:00 p.m., New York City time), on the date when due, in immediately available funds (or such
other form of consideration as the relevant recipient may agree), without setoff or counterclaim (except as
otherwise provided in Section 2.17). Any amounts received after such time on any date may, in the
discretion of the Term Loan Administrative Agent, be deemed to have been received on the next succeeding
Business Day for purposes of calculating interest thereon. All such payments shall be made to such account
as may be specified by the Term Loan Administrative Agent, except that payments pursuant to Section
2.15, Section 2.16, Section 2.17 and Section 9.03 shall be made directly to the Persons entitled thereto and
payments pursuant to other Loan Documents shall be made to the Persons specified therein. The Term Loan
Administrative Agent shall distribute any such payments received by it for the account of any other Person
to the appropriate recipient promptly following receipt thereof. If any payment (other than payments on the
Term Benchmark Loans, which shall be subject to the definition of “Interest Period”) under any Loan
Document shall be due on a day that is not a Business Day, the date for payment shall be extended to the
next succeeding Business Day. If any payment on a Term Benchmark Loan becomes due and payable on a
day other than a Business Day, the date for such payment shall be extended to the next succeeding Business
Day unless the result of such extension would be to extend such payment into another calendar month, in
which event such payment shall be made on the immediately preceding Business Day. In the case of any
payment of principal pursuant to the preceding two sentences, interest thereon shall be payable at the then
applicable rate for the period of such extension. All payments or prepayments of any Loan (or of interest
thereon) shall be made in the currency in which such Loan is denominated (or the Dollar Equivalent
thereof), and all other payments under each Loan Document shall be made in Dollars, in each case, except
as the relevant recipient may otherwise agree.

                 (b)     If at any time insufficient funds are received by and available to the Term Loan
Administrative Agent to pay fully all amounts of principal, interest and fees then due hereunder, such funds
shall be applied in the manner set forth in Section 7.03.

                 (c)      If any Term Lender shall, by exercising any right of setoff or counterclaim or
otherwise, obtain payment in respect of any principal of or interest on any of its Loans of a given Class
resulting in such Term Lender receiving payment of a greater proportion of the aggregate amount of its
Loans of such Class and accrued interest thereon than the proportion received by any other Term Lender
with outstanding Loans of the same Class, then the Term Lender receiving such greater proportion shall
purchase (for cash at face value) participations in the Loans of such Class at such time outstanding to the
extent necessary so that the benefit of all such payments shall be shared by the Term Lenders of such Class
ratably in accordance with the aggregate amount of principal of and accrued interest on their respective
Loans of such Class; provided that (i) if any such participations are purchased and all or any portion of the
payment giving rise thereto is recovered, such participations shall be rescinded and the purchase price
restored to the extent of such recovery, without interest and (ii) the provisions of this clause (c) shall not be
construed to apply to (A) any payment made by the Borrowers pursuant to and in accordance with the
express terms of this Agreement (including the application of funds arising from existence of a Defaulting
Lender), (B) any payment obtained by a Term Lender as consideration for any permitted assignment of or
sale of a participation in any of its Loans to any assignee or participant, including any payment made or
deemed made in connection with Section 2.11(a)(ii), Section 2.21, Section 2.22 or Section 9.02 or (C) any
disproportionate payment obtained by a Term Lender of any Class as a result of the extension by Term
Lenders of the maturity date or expiration date of some but not all Loans or Commitments of that Class or
any increase in the Applicable Rate in respect of Loans of Term Lenders that have consented to any such


extension. The Lead Borrower consents to the foregoing and agrees, to the extent it may effectively do so
under applicable Requirements of Law, that any Term Lender acquiring a participation pursuant to the
foregoing arrangements may exercise against the Borrowers rights of setoff and counterclaim with respect
to such participation as fully as if such Term Lender were a direct creditor of the Borrowers in the amount
of such participation.

                 (d)     Unless the Term Loan Administrative Agent shall have received notice from the
Lead Borrower prior to the date on which any payment is due to the Term Loan Administrative Agent for
the account of the Term Lenders hereunder that the Borrowers will not make such payment, the Term Loan
Administrative Agent may assume that the Borrowers have made such payment on such date in accordance
herewith and may, in reliance upon such assumption and in its sole discretion, distribute to the Term
Lenders the amount due. In such event, if the Borrowers have not in fact made such payment, then each of
the Term Lenders severally agrees to repay to the Term Loan Administrative Agent forthwith on demand
the amount so distributed to such Term Lender with interest thereon, for each day from and including the
date such amount is distributed to it to but excluding the date of payment to the Term Loan Administrative
Agent, at the greater of the Federal Funds Effective Rate and a rate determined by the Term Loan
Administrative Agent in accordance with banking industry rules on interbank compensation.

                (e)      If any Term Lender shall fail to make any payment required to be made by it
pursuant to Section 2.06(a), Section 2.06(b), Section 2.18(d) or Section 9.03(c), then the Term Loan
Administrative Agent may, in its discretion and in the order determined by the Term Loan Administrative
Agent (notwithstanding any contrary provision hereof), apply any amounts thereafter received by the Term
Loan Administrative Agent for the account of such Term Lender to satisfy such Term Lender’s obligations
under such Section until all such unsatisfied obligations are fully paid.

        Section 2.19     Mitigation Obligations; Replacement of Term Lenders.

                 (a)     If (i) any recipient requests compensation under Section 2.15, (ii) any Loan Party
is required to pay any Indemnified Taxes or additional amounts to any recipient or any Governmental
Authority for the account of any recipient pursuant to Section 2.17 or (iii) any event gives rise to the
operation of Section 2.23, then the applicable recipient shall use reasonable efforts to designate a different
lending office for funding or booking its Loans hereunder, or to assign and delegate its rights and obligations
hereunder to another of its offices, branches or Affiliates, if, in the reasonable judgment of such recipient,
such designation or assignment and delegation (x) would eliminate or reduce amounts payable pursuant to
Section 2.15 or Section 2.17 or mitigate the applicability of Section 2.23, as the case may be and (y) would
not subject such recipient to any unreimbursed cost or expense reasonably deemed by such recipient to be
material and would not be inconsistent with the internal policies of, or otherwise be disadvantageous in any
material economic, legal or regulatory respect to, such recipient.

                  (b)     If (i) any Term Lender requests compensation under Section 2.15 or gives notice
under Section 2.23, (ii) any Loan Party is required to pay any Indemnified Taxes or additional amounts to
any Term Lender or to any Governmental Authority for the account of any Term Lender pursuant to Section
2.17 or (iii) any Term Lender becomes a Defaulting Lender, then the Lead Borrower may, at its sole expense
and effort, upon notice to such Term Lender and the Term Loan Administrative Agent, (x) terminate the
applicable Commitments of such Term Lender, and repay all Loan Document Obligations of the Borrowers
owing to such Term Lender relating to the applicable Loans and participations held by such Term Lender
as of such termination date under one or more Credit Facilities as the Lead Borrower may elect or (y) require
such Term Lender to assign and delegate (and such Term Lender shall be obligated to assign and delegate),
without recourse (in accordance with and subject to the restrictions contained in Section 9.04), all its
interests, rights and obligations under this Agreement and the other Loan Documents to an Eligible
Assignee that shall assume such obligations (which assignee may be another Term Lender, if a Term Lender


accepts such assignment and delegation); provided that (A) the Lead Borrower shall have received the prior
written consent of the Term Loan Administrative Agent to the extent such consent would be required under
Section 9.04(b) for an assignment of Loans or Commitments, as applicable, which consents, in each case,
shall not unreasonably be withheld, conditioned or delayed, (B) such Term Lender shall have received
payment of an amount equal to the outstanding principal of its Loans, accrued but unpaid interest thereon,
accrued but unpaid fees and all other amounts payable to it hereunder from the assignee or the Borrowers,
(C) the Borrowers or such assignee shall have paid (unless waived) to the Term Loan Administrative Agent
the processing and recordation fee specified in Section 9.04(b)(ii) and (D) in the case of any such
assignment resulting from a claim for compensation under Section 2.15 or payments required to be made
pursuant to Section 2.17, such assignment will result in a reduction in such compensation or payments
thereafter. A Term Lender shall not be required to make any such assignment and delegation if, prior
thereto, as a result of a waiver by such Term Lender or otherwise (including as a result of any action taken
by such Term Lender under clause (a) above), the circumstances entitling the Lead Borrower to require
such assignment and delegation cease to apply. No action or consent by the applicable Term Lender shall
otherwise be required in connection with any assignment referred to above, which assignment shall be
immediate and automatically effective upon the satisfaction of the foregoing conditions. Each Term Lender
hereby irrevocably appoints the Term Loan Administrative Agent (such appointment being coupled with
an interest) as such Term Lender’s attorney-in-fact, with full authority in the place and stead of such Term
Lender and in the name of such Term Lender, from time to time in the Term Loan Administrative Agent’s
discretion, with prior written notice to such Term Lender, to take any action and to execute any such
assignment or other instrument that the Term Loan Administrative Agent may deem reasonably necessary
to carry out the provisions of this Section 2.19(b).

        Section 2.20    Incremental Loans and Commitments.

                 (a)      Any Loan Party may at any time or from time to time (on one or more occasions)
after the Closing Date, pursuant to an Incremental Facility Amendment add one or more additional Classes
of term loans and/or commitments therefor (including incremental delayed draw term loan commitments)
or additional term loans of the same Class as any existing Class of term loans (an “Incremental Term
Facility”) and/or increase the principal amount of any Class of Term Loans or Term Commitments by
requesting new term loan commitments to be added to such Class of Term Loans or Term Commitments
(each, an “Incremental Term Increase”, and together with any Incremental Term Facility, the “Incremental
Term Loans”); provided that at the applicable time of determination in accordance with Section 1.09(a)
with respect to any such Incremental Term Facility, to the extent required by the lenders providing such
Incremental Term Facility, no Specified Event of Default shall have occurred and be continuing.
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, the aggregate principal amount of the Incremental Term
Facilities that can be incurred at any time shall not exceed the Incremental Cap at such time. Each
Incremental Term Facility shall be in a minimum principal amount (as applicable) of $10,000,000 and
integral multiples of $1,000,000 in excess thereof (unless the Lead Borrower and the Term Loan
Administrative Agent otherwise agree); provided that the principal amount may be less than such amount
or integral multiple if such amount represents all the remaining availability under the aggregate principal
amount of Incremental Term Facilities set forth above.It is understood and agreed that:

                                (i)     any Incremental Term Facility shall rank pari passu with or junior
      to any applicable then-existing Class of Loans in right of payment and pari passu with or junior in
      right of security (if secured), and no Incremental Term Facility shall be guaranteed by any Person
      which is not a Loan Party; provided that, notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, any
      Incremental Term Facility shall not be required to be guaranteed by any Loan Party that does not
      otherwise then guarantee the obligations of the Lead Borrower and/or secured by assets that do not
      secure the Credit Facilities;


                          (ii)     [Reserved].

                           (iii)   other than with respect to an aggregate principal amount at any time
outstanding not to exceed the Incremental Maturity Limitation Excluded Amount (as selected by the
Lead Borrower), the Incremental Term Loans (I) shall not mature earlier than the Latest Maturity
Date of the Initial Term Loans denominated in the same currency outstanding at the time of
incurrence thereof (or the earliest maturity date of the then-existing Initial Term Loans for any
Incremental Term Loan established as the first of its type for any other currency) (determined without
giving effect to any prepayments) and (II) shall not have a shorter Weighted Average Life to Maturity
than the then-remaining Weighted Average Life to Maturity of the then-existing Initial Term Loans
denominated in the same currency as such Incremental Term Loans (or the then-remaining shortest
Weighted Average Life to Maturity of the then-existing Initial Term Loans for any Incremental Term
Loan denominated in the same currency outstanding at the time of incurrence thereof) (determined
without giving effect to any prepayments) (other than, in each case of this clause (iii), (A) any
customary bridge loan facility (as determined by the Lead Borrower in good faith), so long as the
long-term debt into which any such customary bridge facility is to be converted or exchanged satisfies
this clause (iii) or so long as such customary bridge facility is converted or exchanged into equity
securities (including common or preferred) and/or (B) Incremental Term Facilities incurred in
connection with escrow financings so long as upon release from escrow, such Indebtedness otherwise
satisfies the requirements of this clause (iii) (including the preceding subclauses (A) and (B) or does
not exceed the Incremental Maturity Limitation Excluded Amount)),

                          (iv)     the Incremental Term Facilities shall have a currency, a maturity
date (subject to clauses (ii) and (iii)), an amortization schedule (subject to clause (iii)), interest rates
(including through fixed interest rates), interest margins, rate floors, upfront fees, AHYDO Catch-Up
Payments, funding discounts, original issue discount and prepayment terms and premiums as
determined by the Lead Borrower and the lenders of the applicable Incremental Term Facilities;
provided that, in the case of any floating rate term loan “B” Incremental Term Loans denominated in
Dollars that are pari passu in right of payment with the Initial Term Loans and are secured on by the
Collateral on a pari passu basis with the Initial Term Loans, broadly syndicated to banks and/or other
institutional investors and incurred after the Closing Date and prior to the date that is 6 months after
the Closing Date (other than in respect of (A) any such Incremental Term Loans originally incurred
pursuant to the Additional Incurrence-Based Amount and/or the Incremental
Prepayments/Extensions Basket Amount, (B) any such Incremental Term Loans incurred in
connection with a Permitted Acquisition or other permitted Investment or to refinance Indebtedness
incurred in connection with a Permitted Acquisition or other permitted Investment, (C) any such
Incremental Term Loans incurred in connection with any refinancing of any other Indebtedness or
any dividend recapitalization, (D) any such Incremental Term Loans that has a fixed interest rate or
is not a term loan B, (E) any such Incremental Term Loans that are scheduled to mature at least 12
months after the relevant maturity date of the Initial Term Loans in effect at the time of such
incurrence, (F) any such Incremental Term Loans in an aggregate principal amount up to the greater
of (x) $505,000,000 and (y) 200% of Consolidated EBITDA as of the most recently ended Test
Period (as selected by the Lead Borrower) and (G) a customary bridge facility (as determined by the
Lead Borrower in good faith)), in the event that the interest rate margin (the calculation of which
shall not include any “credit spread” or similar adjustment) for such Incremental Term Loans is
greater than the interest margin for the Initial Term Loans by more than 1.00% per annum (calculated
in the same manner and after giving effect to any amendment to interest rate margins under the Initial
Term Loans after the Closing Date, but prior to the time of the addition of such Incremental Term
Loans), then the Applicable Rate for such Initial Term Loans shall be increased to the extent
necessary so that the interest margin for such Initial Term Loans shall not be less than the interest
margin with respect to such Incremental Term Loans denominated in the same currency minus 1.00%


      per annum (the “MFN Adjustment”, and this proviso, the “MFN Protection”) (solely to the extent
      that the Term Lenders holding more than 50% of the aggregate amount of the loans under the Initial
      Term Facility have not waived the MFN Adjustment); it being understood and agreed that whether,
      and to what extent, the MFN Adjustment applies shall be determined, at the election of the Lead
      Borrower, solely as of (and based solely on the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio (or other applicable
      metric) on) either (1) the date of the initial funding of such Incremental Term Facility or (2) the date
      on which such Incremental Term Facility is allocated in primary syndication;

                                 (v)     (A) Incremental Term Loans may provide for the ability to
      participate on a pro rata basis or non-pro rata basis in any voluntary prepayments of Term Loans and
      (B) any offer to prepay (other than any scheduled amortization payment) Incremental Term Loans
      shall be made on a pro rata basis with such existing applicable Term Loans, except that the Lead
      Borrower and the lenders providing the relevant Incremental Term Loans shall be permitted, in their
      sole discretion, to elect to prepay or receive, as applicable, any such prepayment on a less than pro
      rata basis (but not on a greater than pro rata basis (other than with respect to Credit Agreement
      Refinancing Indebtedness or as provided for in any Refinancing Amendment and/or Loan
      Modification Offer)) as set forth herein; and

                              (vi)    the Incremental Term Loans may otherwise have terms and
      conditions different from those of the Term Loans as agreed between the Lead Borrower and the
      lenders providing such Incremental Term Loans.

                Notwithstanding the foregoing, concurrent application of the Incremental Maturity
        Limitation Excluded Amount pursuant to clauses (ii) and (iii) above (with respect to maturity and
        Weighted Average Life to Maturity) shall be deemed only a single application of the Incremental
        Maturity Limitation Excluded Amount (i.e., a $50,000,000 incurrence with both a shorter maturity
        date and shorter Weighted Average Life to Maturity shall be a $50,000,000 usage of such exception
        (assuming other exclusions are inapplicable at such time)).

                (c)      [Reserved]

                (d)      [Reserved].

                  (e)      Commitments in respect of Incremental Term Loans shall become Commitments
under this Agreement pursuant to an amendment (an “Incremental Facility Amendment”) to this Agreement
and, as appropriate, the other Loan Documents, executed by the Lead Borrower, each Term Lender or
Additional Lender, if any, agreeing to provide such Commitments (it being agreed that any Person other
than a Term Lender agreeing to provide such Commitment shall be required to meet the requirements set
forth in the definition of “Additional Lender”), and the Term Loan Administrative Agent. Each Incremental
Term Loan shall be a “Loan” for all purposes of this Agreement and the other Loan Documents. The
Incremental Facility Amendment may, without the consent of any other Term Lenders, effect such
amendments to this Agreement and the other Loan Documents as may be necessary, in the reasonable
opinion of the Term Loan Administrative Agent and the Lead Borrower, to effect the provisions of this
Section 2.20 (including, without limitation, to modify the terms of this Agreement to appropriately
incorporate additional currency mechanics), additional revolving or letter of credit facility mechanics
(including those related to payments, prepayments, purchases of participations and reallocation
mechanisms) and other provisions and commitment schedules relating to revolving or letter of credit
facilities generally). The effectiveness of any Incremental Facility Amendment and the occurrence of any
Credit Extension pursuant to such Incremental Facility Amendment shall be subject to the satisfaction of
such conditions as the parties thereto shall agree (subject to the provisions of this Section 2.20).


                 (f)     [Reserved].

                 (g)      Incremental Term Facilities may be provided by any existing Term Lender (in its
sole discretion) or any Additional Lender; provided that any Additional Lender that is an Affiliated Lender
shall be subject to the provisions of Section 9.04(g), mutatis mutandis, to the same extent as if the relevant
Incremental Term Facility had been acquired by such Additional Lender by way of assignment. Each Term
Lender or Additional Lender providing a portion of any Incremental Term Facility shall execute and deliver
to the Term Loan Administrative Agent and the Lead Borrower all such documentation (including the
relevant Incremental Facility Amendment) as may be reasonably required by the Term Loan Administrative
Agent to evidence and effectuate such Incremental Term Facility. On the effective date of such Incremental
Term Facility, each Additional Lender shall become a Term Lender for all purposes in connection with this
Agreement.

                 (h)      The Term Lenders hereby irrevocably authorize the Term Loan Administrative
Agent to enter into any Incremental Facility Amendment and/or any amendment to any other Loan
Document with the Lead Borrower as may be necessary or appropriate in order to establish any new Class
or any increase in any Classes or sub-Classes in respect of Loans or Commitments pursuant to this Section
2.20 (including, for instance, to increase the amortization of any existing Class of Term Loans (or to provide
for any existing Class of Term Loans to have (or to again have) amortization) in order to have such existing
Class of Term Loans be “fungible” with any Incremental Term Facility that is to be added to such Loans)
and such technical amendments as may be necessary or appropriate in the reasonable opinion of the Term
Loan Administrative Agent and the Lead Borrower in connection with the establishment or increase, as
applicable, of such Classes or sub-Classes, in each case on terms consistent with this Section 2.20.

                (i)      Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, this Section 2.20 shall supersede any
provisions in Section 2.18 or Section 9.02 to the contrary.

        Section 2.21     Refinancing Amendments.

              (a)    At any time after the Closing Date, the Borrowers or any Loan Party may obtain,
from any Term Lender or any Additional Lender, Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness in respect
of:

                              (i)    all or any portion of the Term Loans (or Commitments therefor) then
      outstanding under this Agreement (including any then outstanding Other Term Loans or Incremental
      Term Loans),

with respect to the foregoing clause (i), pursuant to a Refinancing Amendment; provided, that:

                                   (A)    such Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness will have such
pricing (including interest, fees and premiums) and optional prepayment (or redemption) terms as may be
agreed by the Borrowers and the Term Lenders thereof;

                                (B)     the proceeds of such Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness
shall be applied, substantially concurrently with the incurrence thereof, to the prepayment of the
Indebtedness being so refinanced or replaced, as the case may be;

                                  (C)      each Class of Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness
incurred under this Section 2.21 shall be in an aggregate principal amount that is not less than (as applicable)
$10,000,000 and integral multiples of $1,000,000 in excess thereof (unless the Lead Borrower and the Term
Loan Administrative Agent otherwise agree).


                 (b)     Term Loan Administrative Agent shall promptly notify each Term Lender as to
the effectiveness of each Refinancing Amendment. Each of the parties hereto hereby agrees that, upon the
effectiveness of any Refinancing Amendment, this Agreement shall be deemed amended to the extent (but
only to the extent) necessary to reflect the existence and terms of the Credit Agreement Refinancing
Indebtedness incurred pursuant thereto (including any amendments necessary to treat the Loans and
Commitments subject thereto as Other Term Loans and/or Other Term Commitments). Any Refinancing
Amendment may, without the consent of any other Term Lenders, effect such amendments to this
Agreement and the other Loan Documents as may be necessary or appropriate, in the reasonable opinion
of the Term Loan Administrative Agent and the Lead Borrower, to effect the provisions of this Section
2.21.

                 (c)     Refinancing facilities may be provided by any existing Term Lender (in its sole
discretion) or any Additional Lender; provided that any Additional Lender that is an Affiliated Lender shall
be subject to the provisions of Section 9.04(g), mutatis mutandis, to the same extent as if the relevant
Refinancing facility had been acquired by such Additional Lender by way of assignment.

                (d)      Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, this Section 2.21 shall supersede any
provisions in Section 2.18 or Section 9.02 to the contrary.

        Section 2.22    Defaulting Lenders.

               (a)      General. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, if
any Term Lender becomes a Defaulting Lender, then, until such time as that Term Lender is no longer a
Defaulting Lender, to the extent permitted by applicable Requirements of Law:

                              (i)   Waivers and Amendments. Such Defaulting Lender’s right to
      approve or disapprove any amendment, waiver or consent with respect to this Agreement or any other
      Loan Document shall be restricted as set forth in the definition of Required Lenders and Section
      9.02(d).

                              (ii)    Reallocation of Payments. Any payment of principal, interest, fees
      or other amounts received by the Term Loan Administrative Agent for the account of that Defaulting
      Lender (whether voluntary or mandatory, at maturity, pursuant to Article VII or otherwise, and
      including any amounts made available to the Term Loan Administrative Agent by that Defaulting
      Lender pursuant to Section 9.08), shall be applied at such time or times as may be determined by the
      Term Loan Administrative Agent and, where relevant, the Lead Borrower, as follows:

                             (A)      first, to the payment of any amounts owing by that Defaulting
Lender to the Term Loan Administrative Agent hereunder;

                                (B)     second, to the payment on a pro rata basis of any amounts owing
by that Defaulting Lender to any other Term Lender, hereunder;

                                 (C)     [reserved];

                                 (D)      third, as the Lead Borrower may request (so long as no Default or
Event of Default is continuing), to the funding of any Loan in respect of which that Defaulting Lender has
failed to fund its portion thereof as required by this Agreement, as determined by the Term Loan
Administrative Agent;


                               (E)      fourth, if so determined by the Term Loan Administrative Agent
and the Lead Borrower, to be held in a deposit account and released in order to satisfy obligations of that
Defaulting Lender to fund Loans under this Agreement;

                                (F)      fifth, to the payment of any amounts owing to the non-Defaulting
Lenders as a result of any judgment of a court of competent jurisdiction obtained by any non-Defaulting
Lender against that Defaulting Lender as a result of that Defaulting Lender’s breach of its obligations under
this Agreement;

                                 (G)     sixth, so long as no Event of Default has occurred and is
continuing, to the payment of any amounts owing to any Borrower as a result of any judgment of a court of
competent jurisdiction obtained by any Borrower against that Defaulting Lender as a result of that
Defaulting Lender’s breach of its obligations under this Agreement; and

                                  (H)     seventh, to that Defaulting Lender or as otherwise directed by a
court of competent jurisdiction; provided that if such payment is a payment of the principal amount of any
Loans such Term Lender is a Defaulting Lender under clause (a) of the definition thereof, such payment
shall be applied solely to pay the relevant Loans of the relevant non-Defaulting Lenders on a pro rata basis
prior to being applied to the payment of any Loans of such Defaulting Lender. Any payments, prepayments
or other amounts paid or payable to a Defaulting Lender that are applied (or held) to pay amounts owed by
a Defaulting Lender pursuant to this Section 2.22 shall be deemed paid to and redirected by that Defaulting
Lender, and each Term Lender irrevocably consents hereto.

                  (b)     Defaulting Lender Cure. If the Lead Borrower and the Term Loan Administrative
Agent agree in writing in their sole discretion that a Defaulting Lender should no longer be deemed to be a
Defaulting Lender, the Term Loan Administrative Agent will so notify the parties hereto, whereupon as of
the effective date specified in such notice and subject to any conditions set forth therein, such Term Lender
will, to the extent applicable, purchase that portion of outstanding Loans of the other Term Lenders or take
such other actions as the Term Loan Administrative Agent may determine to be necessary to cause the
Loans and funded, whereupon that Term Lender will cease to be a Defaulting Lender; provided that no
adjustments will be made retroactively with respect to fees accrued or payments made by or on behalf of
the Borrowers while that Term Lender was a Defaulting Lender; and provided, further, that except to the
extent otherwise expressly agreed by the affected parties, no change hereunder from Defaulting Lender to
Term Lender will constitute a waiver or release of any claim of any party hereunder arising from that Term
Lender’s having been a Defaulting Lender.

          Section 2.23     Illegality. If any Term Lender determines that any Change in Law has made it
unlawful or not possible in practice, or that any Governmental Authority has asserted after the Closing Date
that it is unlawful, for any Term Lender to make, maintain or fund Loans whose interest is determined by
reference to the Term SOFR, or to determine or charge interest rates based upon the Term SOFR, then, on
notice thereof by such Term Lender to the Lead Borrower through the Term Loan Administrative Agent,
any obligation of such Term Lender to make, continue or charge interest with respect to any such Term
SOFR Loans, or to convert ABR Loans to Term SOFR Loans shall be suspended (and, if such notice asserts
the illegality of such Term Lender’s making or maintaining ABR Loans, the interest rate of which is
determined by reference to clause (c) of the definition of “Alternate Base Rate”, the interest rate with respect
to such ABR Loans shall, to the extent necessary to avoid illegality, be determined by the Term Loan
Administrative Agent without reference to clause (c) of the definition of “Alternate Base Rate”) until such
Term Lender notifies the Term Loan Administrative Agent and the Lead Borrower that the circumstances
giving rise to such determination no longer exist. Upon receipt of such notice, (x) the Borrowers shall, upon
three Business Days’ notice from such Term Lender (with a copy to the Term Loan Administrative Agent),
prepay or, at the Lead Borrower’s election, without regard to underlying currency, convert all Term SOFR


Loans of such Term Lender to ABR Loans, either on the last day of the Interest Period therefor, if such
Term Lender may lawfully continue to maintain such Term SOFR Loans to such day, or immediately, if
such Term Lender may not lawfully continue to maintain such Term SOFR Loans (in which case the
Borrowers shall not be required to make payments pursuant to Section 2.16 in connection with such
payment), and (y) if such notice asserts the illegality of such Term Lender determining or charging interest
rates based upon the Term SOFR, the Term Loan Administrative Agent shall, during the period of such
suspension, compute the Alternate Base Rate applicable to such Term Lender without reference to the Term
SOFR component thereof until the Term Loan Administrative Agent is advised in writing by such Term
Lender that it is no longer illegal for such Term Lender to determine or charge interest rates based upon the
Term SOFR. Each Term Lender agrees to notify the Term Loan Administrative Agent and the Lead
Borrower in writing promptly upon becoming aware that it is no longer illegal for such Term Lender to
determine or charge interest rates based upon the Term SOFR. Upon any such prepayment or conversion,
the Borrowers shall also pay accrued interest on the amount so prepaid or converted, but shall not be
required to make payments pursuant to Section 2.16.

        Section 2.24     Loan Modification Offers.

                 (a)      At any time after the Closing Date, the Lead Borrower may on one or more
occasions, by written notice to the Term Loan Administrative Agent (or telephonic notice promptly
confirmed thereafter by delivery of a written notice), make one or more offers (each, a “Loan Modification
Offer”) to all the Term Lenders of one or more Classes (each Class subject to such a Loan Modification
Offer, an “Affected Class”) to effect one or more Permitted Amendments relating to such Affected Class
pursuant to procedures reasonably specified by the Term Loan Administrative Agent and reasonably
acceptable to the Lead Borrower (including mechanics to permit cashless rollovers and exchanges by Term
Lenders). Such notice shall set forth (i) the terms and conditions of the requested Permitted Amendment
and (ii) the date on which such Permitted Amendment is requested to become effective. Permitted
Amendments shall become effective only with respect to the Loans and Commitments of the Term Lenders
of the Affected Class that accept the applicable Loan Modification Offer (such Term Lenders, the
“Accepting Lenders”) and, in the case of any Accepting Lender, only with respect to such Term Lender’s
Loans and Commitments of such Affected Class as to which such Term Lender’s acceptance has been
made. A Permitted Amendment shall be effected pursuant to a Loan Modification Agreement executed and
delivered by the Lead Borrower, each applicable Accepting Lender and the Term Loan Administrative
Agent; provided that no Permitted Amendment shall become effective unless the Lead Borrower shall have
delivered to the Term Loan Administrative Agent customary legal opinions, board resolutions, secretary’s
certificates and officer’s certificates as shall be reasonably requested by the Term Loan Administrative
Agent in connection therewith, in each case substantially in the form delivered on the Closing Date (with
appropriate modification thereto to reflect the nature of the Loan Modification Offer). The Term Loan
Administrative Agent shall promptly notify each Term Lender as to the effectiveness of each Loan
Modification Agreement. Each Loan Modification Agreement may, without the consent of any Term
Lender other than the applicable Accepting Lenders, effect such amendments to this Agreement and the
other Loan Documents as may be necessary or appropriate, in the opinion of the Term Loan Administrative
Agent, to give effect to the provisions of this Section 2.24, including any amendments necessary to treat
the applicable Loans and/or Commitments of the Accepting Lenders as a new “Class” of loans and/or
commitments hereunder.

                (b)      If, in connection with any proposed Loan Modification Offer, any Term Lender
declines to consent to such Loan Modification Offer on the terms and by the deadline set forth in such Loan
Modification Offer (each such Term Lender, a “Non-Accepting Lender”) then the Lead Borrower may, on
notice to the Term Loan Administrative Agent and the Non-Accepting Lender, (i) replace such Non-
Accepting Lender by causing such Term Lender to (and such Term Lender shall be obligated to) assign and
delegate, without recourse (in accordance with and subject to the restrictions contained in Section 9.04) all


of its interests, rights and obligations under this Agreement in respect of the Loans and Commitments of
the Affected Class to one or more Eligible Assignees (which Eligible Assignee may be another Term
Lender, if a Term Lender accepts such assignment) or (ii) terminate the applicable Commitments of such
Term Lender and prepay such Non-Accepting Lender; provided that neither the Term Loan Administrative
Agent nor any Term Lender shall have any obligation to the Lead Borrower to find a replacement Term
Lender; provided, further, that (1) the applicable assignee shall have agreed to provide Loans and/or
Commitments on the terms set forth in the applicable Permitted Amendment, (2) such Non-Accepting
Lender shall have received payment of an amount equal to the outstanding principal of the Loans of the
Affected Class assigned by it pursuant to this Section 2.24(b), accrued interest thereon, accrued fees and all
other amounts payable to it hereunder from the Eligible Assignee (to the extent of such outstanding principal
and accrued interest and fees), (3) unless waived, the applicable Borrower or such Eligible Assignee shall
have paid to the Term Loan Administrative Agent the processing and recordation fee specified in Section
9.04(b) and (4) such Non-Accepting Lender shall be entitled to any prepayment premiums or penalties from
the Borrowers to the extent a premium or penalty would be due in respect of a prepayment of Term Loans
pursuant to Section 2.11. Each Term Lender hereby irrevocably appoints the Term Loan Administrative
Agent (such appointment being coupled with an interest) as such Non-Accepting Lender’s attorney-in-fact,
with full authority in the place and stead of such Non-Accepting Lender and in the name of such Non-
Accepting Lender, from time to time in the Term Loan Administrative Agent’s discretion, with prior written
notice to such Term Lender, to take any action and to execute any such assignment or other instrument that
the Term Loan Administrative Agent may deem reasonably necessary to carry out the provisions of this
Section 2.24(b).

                (c)      Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, this Section 2.24 shall supersede any
provisions in Section 2.18 or Section 9.02 to the contrary.

        Section 2.25     Permitted Debt Exchanges.

                   (a)       Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, pursuant to
one or more offers (each, a “Permitted Debt Exchange Offer”) made from time to time by the Lead
Borrower to all Term Lenders of a Class (other than, with respect to any Permitted Debt Exchange Offer
that constitutes an offering of securities, any Term Lender that, if requested by the Lead Borrower, is unable
to certify that it is (i) a “qualified institutional buyer” (as defined in Rule 144A under the Securities Act),
(ii) an institutional “accredited investor” (as defined in Rule 501 under the Securities Act) or (iii) not a
“U.S. person” (as defined in Rule 902 under the Securities Act)) with outstanding Term Loans of a
particular Class, the Lead Borrower may from time to time consummate one or more exchanges of such
Term Loans for Indebtedness (in the form of senior secured, senior unsecured, senior subordinated or
subordinated notes or loans) (such Indebtedness, “Permitted Debt Exchange Notes” and each such
exchange, a “Permitted Debt Exchange”), so long as the following conditions are satisfied:

                                 (i)     each such Permitted Debt Exchange Offer shall be made on a pro
      rata basis to the Term Lenders of such Class (other than, with respect to any Permitted Debt Exchange
      Offer that constitutes an offering of securities, any Term Lender that, if requested by the Lead
      Borrower, is unable to certify that it is (i) a “qualified institutional buyer” (as defined in Rule 144A
      under the Securities Act), (ii) an institutional “accredited investor” (as defined in Rule 501 under the
      Securities Act) or (iii) not a “U.S. person” (as defined in Rule 902 under the Securities Act)) of each
      applicable Class based on their respective aggregate principal amounts of outstanding Term Loans
      under each such Class;

                              (ii)   the aggregate principal amount (calculated on the face amount
      thereof) of such Permitted Debt Exchange Notes shall not exceed the aggregate principal amount
      (calculated on the face amount thereof) of Term Loans so refinanced, except (A) to the extent a


different incurrence basket pursuant to Section 6.01 is utilized and/or (B) with respect to an amount
equal to unpaid accrued interest, penalties and premium (including tender premiums) thereon on the
Term Loans so refinanced and any fees, expenses, commissions, underwriting discounts and
premiums payable in connection with such Permitted Debt Exchange;

                          (iii)    other than with respect to an aggregate principal amount at any time
outstanding not to exceed the Refinancing Maturity Limitation Excluded Amount (as selected by the
Lead Borrower), the stated final maturity of such Permitted Debt Exchange Notes is not earlier than
the Latest Maturity Date for the Class or Classes of Term Loans being exchanged, and such stated
final maturity is not subject to any conditions that could result in such stated final maturity occurring
on a date that precedes such Latest Maturity Date (it being understood that acceleration or mandatory
repayment, prepayment, redemption or repurchase of such Permitted Debt Exchange Notes, in each
case, as permitted hereunder, shall not constitute a change in the stated final maturity thereof);

                           (iv)   such Permitted Debt Exchange Notes are not required to be repaid,
prepaid, redeemed, repurchased or defeased, whether on one or more fixed dates, upon the occurrence
of one or more events or at the option of any holder thereof (except, in each case, upon the occurrence
of an event of default, a change of control or change in control, an event of loss or an asset disposition
or with an amount equal to excess cash flow) prior to the Latest Maturity Date for the Class or Classes
of Term Loans being exchanged; provided that, notwithstanding the foregoing, scheduled
amortization payments (however denominated, including scheduled offers to repurchase) of such
Permitted Debt Exchange Notes shall be permitted so long as (other than with respect to an aggregate
principal amount thereof not to exceed the Refinancing Maturity Limitation Excluded Amount (as
selected by the Lead Borrower)) the Weighted Average Life to Maturity of such Indebtedness shall
be no earlier than the then-remaining Weighted Average Life to Maturity of the Class or Classes of
Term Loans being exchanged;

                         (v)    neither BIF II nor any Subsidiary of the Lead Borrower or BIF II is
an issuer, a borrower or a guarantor with respect to such Indebtedness unless such Subsidiary is or
substantially concurrently becomes a Loan Party; provided that Permitted Debt Exchange Notes
issued by the Lead Borrower (or Subsidiaries of the Lead Borrower or BIF II in place of such
Indebtedness issued by the Lead Borrower (or applicable successor thereto, including in connection
with prior refinancing or Incremental Term Facilities) may be guaranteed and/or secured on
differentiating terms in a manner generally consistent, in the good faith determination of the Lead
Borrower, with the differing guarantee and Collateral arrangements on the Closing Date);

                           (vi)    if such Permitted Debt Exchange Notes are secured, such Permitted
Debt Exchange Notes are secured on a pari passu basis (without regard to the control of remedies)
or junior priority basis to the Secured Obligations and (A) such Permitted Debt Exchange Notes are
not secured by any assets not securing the Secured Obligations unless such assets substantially
concurrently secure the Secured Obligations and (B) the beneficiaries thereof (or an agent on their
behalf) shall become party to an Intercreditor Agreement; provided that Permitted Debt Exchange
Notes issued by the Borrowers (or Subsidiaries of BIF II or the Borrowers in place of such
Indebtedness issued by the Borrowers (or applicable successor thereto, including in connection with
prior refinancing or Incremental Term Facilities)) may be guaranteed and/or secured on
differentiating terms in a manner generally consistent with the differing guarantee and Collateral
arrangements on the Closing Date;

                         (vii)   such Permitted Debt Exchange Notes have covenants and events of
default (excluding optional prepayment and redemption terms) that (i) in the good faith determination
of the Lead Borrower, at the time the definitive documentation with respect thereto is finalized, reflect


market terms and conditions at the time of the issuance, incurrence or effectiveness of such Permitted
Debt Exchange Notes or (ii) are substantially identical to or not materially more favorable to the
lenders or investors providing such Permitted Debt Exchange Notes than the Term Loans being
exchanged (it being understood that, in the case of this clause (ii), to the extent that any covenant or
other provision is added for the benefit of any such Permitted Debt Exchange Notes, this clause (ii)
shall be satisfied if such covenant or other provision is either (x) also added for the benefit of the
Initial Term Facility other than the Term Loans being exchanged (and any such addition shall not
require the consent of the Term Loan Administrative Agent or any of the Term Lenders) or (y) only
applicable after the Latest Maturity Date at the time of such refinancing), in each case with respect
to clauses (i) and (ii) above, when taken as a whole and as determined by the Lead Borrower in good
faith at the time the definitive documentation with respect thereto is finalized;

                         (viii) all Term Loans exchanged under each applicable Class by the
Borrowers pursuant to any Permitted Debt Exchange shall automatically be cancelled and retired by
the Borrowers on the date of the settlement thereof (and, if requested by the Term Loan
Administrative Agent, any applicable exchanging Term Lender shall execute and deliver to the Term
Loan Administrative Agent an Assignment and Assumption, or such other form as may be reasonably
requested by the Term Loan Administrative Agent, in respect thereof pursuant to which the respective
Term Lender assigns its interest in the Term Loans being exchanged pursuant to the Permitted Debt
Exchange to the Lead Borrower for immediate cancellation), and accrued and unpaid interest on such
Term Loans shall be paid to the exchanging Term Lenders on the date of consummation of such
Permitted Debt Exchange, or, if agreed to by the Lead Borrower and the Term Loan Administrative
Agent, the next scheduled Interest Payment Date with respect to such Term Loans (with such interest
accruing until the date of consummation of such Permitted Debt Exchange);

                          (ix)    if the aggregate principal amount of all Term Loans (calculated on
the face amount thereof) of a given Class tendered by Term Lenders in respect of the relevant
Permitted Debt Exchange Offer (with no Term Lender being permitted to tender a principal amount
of Term Loans which exceeds the principal amount thereof of the applicable Class actually held by
it) shall exceed the maximum aggregate principal amount of Term Loans of such Class offered to be
exchanged by the Lead Borrower pursuant to such Permitted Debt Exchange Offer, then the Lead
Borrower shall exchange Term Loans under the relevant Class tendered by such Term Lenders ratably
up to such maximum based on the respective principal amounts so tendered, or, if such Permitted
Debt Exchange Offer shall have been made with respect to multiple Classes without specifying a
maximum aggregate principal amount offered to be exchanged for each Class, and the Dollar
Equivalent of the aggregate principal amount of all Term Loans (calculated on the face amount
thereof) of all Classes tendered by Term Lenders in respect of the relevant Permitted Debt Exchange
Offer (with no Term Lender being permitted to tender a principal amount of Term Loans which
exceeds the principal amount thereof actually held by it) shall exceed the Dollar Equivalent of the
maximum aggregate principal amount of Term Loans of all relevant Classes offered to be exchanged
by the Lead Borrower pursuant to such Permitted Debt Exchange Offer, then the Lead Borrower shall
exchange Term Loans across all Classes subject to such Permitted Debt Exchange Offer tendered by
such Term Lenders ratably up to such maximum amount based on the respective principal amounts
so tendered;

                         (x)     all documentation in respect of such Permitted Debt Exchange shall
be consistent with the foregoing; and

                        (xi)     any applicable Minimum Tender Condition or Maximum Tender
Condition, as the case may be, shall be satisfied or waived by the Lead Borrower.


Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, (1) no Term Lender shall have any obligation to agree to
have any of its Loans or Commitments exchanged pursuant to any Permitted Debt Exchange Offer and
(2) this Section 2.25 shall not limit the right of the Lead Borrower or any Term Lender to consummate an
“exchange” or similar transaction in accordance with any other provision of this Agreement.

                 (b)     With respect to all Permitted Debt Exchanges effected by the applicable
Borrower(s) pursuant to this Section 2.25, such Permitted Debt Exchange Offer shall be made for not less
than (as applicable) $10,000,000 in aggregate principal amount of Term Loans; provided that subject to the
foregoing, the applicable Borrower may at its election specify (A) as a condition to consummating any such
Permitted Debt Exchange that a minimum amount (to be determined and specified in the relevant Permitted
Debt Exchange Offer in the Lead Borrower’s discretion) of Term Loans of any or all applicable Classes be
tendered (a “Minimum Tender Condition”) and/or (B) as a condition to consummating any such Permitted
Debt Exchange that no more than a maximum amount (to be determined and specified in the relevant
Permitted Debt Exchange Offer in the applicable Borrower’s discretion) of Term Loans of any or all
applicable Classes will be accepted for exchange (a “Maximum Tender Condition”). The Term Loan
Administrative Agent and the Term Lenders hereby acknowledge and agree that the provisions of Section
2.11 (other than Section 2.11(a)), Section 2.18 and Section 2.20 shall not apply to any Permitted Debt
Exchange or the other transactions contemplated by this Section 2.25.

                  (c)     In connection with each Permitted Debt Exchange, the Lead Borrower shall
provide the Term Loan Administrative Agent at least five (5) Business Days’ (or such shorter period as
may be agreed by the Term Loan Administrative Agent) prior written notice thereof (or telephonic notice
promptly confirmed thereafter by delivery of a written notice), and the Lead Borrower and the Term Loan
Administrative Agent, acting reasonably, shall mutually agree to such procedures as may be necessary or
advisable to accomplish the purposes of this Section 2.25; provided that the terms of any Permitted Debt
Exchange Offer shall provide that the date by which the relevant Term Lenders are required to indicate
their election to participate in such Permitted Debt Exchange shall be not less than five (5) Business Days
following the date on which the Permitted Debt Exchange Offer is made. The Borrower shall provide the
final results of such Permitted Debt Exchange to the Term Loan Administrative Agent no later than three
(3) Business Days prior to the proposed date of effectiveness for such Permitted Debt Exchange (or such
shorter period agreed to by the Term Loan Administrative Agent in its sole discretion) and the Term Loan
Administrative Agent shall be entitled to conclusively rely on such results.

                (d)      The Borrowers shall be responsible for compliance with, and hereby agree to
comply with, all applicable securities and other laws in connection with each Permitted Debt Exchange, it
being understood and agreed that (i) neither the Term Loan Administrative Agent nor any Term Lender
assumes any responsibility in connection with the Borrowers’ compliance with such laws in connection
with any Permitted Debt Exchange and (ii) each Term Lender shall be solely responsible for its compliance
with any applicable “insider trading” laws and regulations to which such Term Lender may be subject under
the Exchange Act.

        Section 2.26    Inability to Determine Rates.

                (a)     If, with respect to any Term Benchmark Loan:

                              (i)    the Term Loan Administrative Agent determines in its reasonable
      discretion (which determination shall be conclusive and binding absent manifest error) that a
      fundamental change has occurred such that adequate and reasonable means do not exist for
      determining the relevant Benchmark pursuant to the relevant definitions therein, including as a result
      of a Benchmark Transition Event, or


                              (ii)   the Required Lenders determine that for any reason in connection
      with any request for a Term Benchmark Loan or a conversion thereto or a continuation thereof that
      the Benchmark for any requested currency (or Interest Period, if applicable) with respect to a
      proposed Term Benchmark Loan does not adequately and fairly reflect the cost to such Term Lenders
      of funding such Loan, and, in each case, the Required Lenders have provided notice of such
      determination to the Term Loan Administrative Agent,

        the Term Loan Administrative Agent will promptly (or in respect of a Benchmark Transition Event,
        when the administrator of a then-current Benchmark has permanently or indefinitely ceased to
        provide such Benchmark or such Benchmark has been announced by the regulatory supervisor for
        the administrator of such Benchmark pursuant to public statement or publication of information to
        be no longer representative of the underlying market and economic reality that such Benchmark is
        intended to measure and that representativeness will not be restored) so notify the Lead Borrower
        and each Term Lender, as applicable. Thereafter, (x) the obligation of the Term Lenders to make
        or maintain Term Benchmark Loans, or to convert Loans to Term Benchmark Loans, in each case,
        shall be suspended (and if a Term Benchmark Loan, to the extent of the affected Term Benchmark
        Loans or Interest Periods) until the Term Loan Administrative Agent (upon the instruction of the
        Required Lenders) revokes such notice and (y) if such determination pursuant to Section 2.26(a)(i)
        affects the calculation of Alternate Base Rate, the Term Loan Administrative Agent shall during
        the period of such suspension compute Alternate Base Rate without reference to clause (c) of the
        definition of “Alternate Base Rate” until the Term Loan Administrative Agent revokes such notice.

                Upon receipt of such notice:

                                  (A)    the Lead Borrower may revoke any pending request for a
borrowing of, conversion to or continuation of affected Term Benchmark Loans in each such affected
currency (and if a Term Benchmark Loan, to the extent of the affected Term Benchmark Loans or Interest
Periods) or, failing that, in the case of any request for an affected Term SOFR Borrowing, the Lead
Borrower will be deemed to have converted any such request into a request for a Borrowing of or conversion
to (x) Daily Simple SOFR Borrowings (if available), or (y) if Daily Simple SOFR Borrowings are not
available, ABR Borrowings, in each case, in the amount specified therein, and

                                   (B)     any outstanding affected Term SOFR Loans will be deemed to
have been converted into (x) Daily Simple SOFR Loans (if available), or (y) if Daily Simple SOFR Loans
are not available, ABR Loans, in each case, at the end of the applicable immediately upcoming Interest
Payment Date. Upon any such prepayment or conversion, the Borrowers shall also pay accrued interest on
the amount so prepaid or converted, together with any additional amounts required pursuant to Section 2.16.
It is understood and agreed that if Daily Simple SOFR would be less than the applicable Floor (if any) Daily
Simple SOFR will be deemed to be the applicable Floor for the purposes of this Section 2.26.

               (b)   Benchmark Replacements. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein or in
any other Loan Document:

                              (i)     Replacements of Benchmarks. Notwithstanding anything to the
      contrary herein or in any other Loan Document, if a Benchmark Transition Event and its related
      Benchmark Replacement Date have occurred prior to any setting of the then-current Benchmark, then
      (x) if a Benchmark Replacement is determined in accordance with clause (a) of the definition of
      “Benchmark Replacement” for such Benchmark Replacement Date, such Benchmark Replacement
      will replace such Benchmark for all purposes hereunder and under any Loan Document in respect of
      such Benchmark setting and subsequent Benchmark settings without any amendment to, or further
      action or consent of any other party to, this Agreement or any other Loan Document and (y) if a


Benchmark Replacement is determined in accordance with clause (b) of the definition of “Benchmark
Replacement” for such Benchmark Replacement Date, such Benchmark Replacement will replace
such Benchmark for all purposes hereunder and under any Loan Document in respect of any
Benchmark setting at or after 5:00 p.m. (Local Time) on the fifth (5th) Business Day after the date
notice of such Benchmark Replacement is provided to the Term Lenders without any amendment to,
or further action or consent of any other party to, this Agreement or any other Loan Document so
long as the Term Loan Administrative Agent has not received, by such time, written notice of
objection to such Benchmark Replacement from Term Lenders comprising the Required Lenders.

                          (ii)    Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes. In connection
with the implementation and administration of a Benchmark Replacement, the Term Loan
Administrative Agent will have the right, in consultation with the Lead Borrower, to make
Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes from time to time and, notwithstanding anything to
the contrary herein or in any other Loan Document, any amendments implementing such Benchmark
Replacement Conforming Changes will become effective without any further action or consent of
any other party to this Agreement.

                          (iii)   Notices; Standards for Decisions and Determinations. The Term
Loan Administrative Agent will promptly notify the Lead Borrower and the affected Term Lenders
of (i) the implementation of any Benchmark Replacement and (ii) the effectiveness of any
Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes. The Term Loan Administrative Agent will promptly
notify the Lead Borrower of (x) the removal or reinstatement of any tenor of a Benchmark pursuant
to Section 2.26(b)(iv) and (y) the commencement of any Benchmark Unavailability Period. Any
determination, decision or election that may be made by the Term Loan Administrative Agent or, if
applicable, the Lead Borrower or any Term Lender (or group of Term Lenders) pursuant to this
Section 2.26(b)(iii), including any determination with respect to a tenor, rate or adjustment or of the
occurrence or non-occurrence of an event, circumstance or date and any decision to take or refrain
from taking any action, will be conclusive and binding absent manifest error and may be made in its
or their sole discretion and without consent from any other party hereto, except, in each case, as
expressly required pursuant to this Section 2.26.

                         (iv)    Unavailability of Tenor of Benchmark. Notwithstanding anything to
the contrary herein or in any other Loan Document, at any time (including in connection with the
implementation of a Benchmark Replacement), (i) if the then-current Benchmark is a term rate and
either (A) any tenor for such Benchmark is not displayed on a screen or other information service
that publishes such rate from time to time as selected by the Term Loan Administrative Agent in its
reasonable discretion or (B) the regulatory supervisor for the administrator of such Benchmark has
provided a public statement or publication of information announcing that any tenor for such
Benchmark is not or will not be representative, then the Term Loan Administrative Agent may
remove such unavailable or non-representative tenor and (ii) if a tenor that was removed pursuant to
clause (i) above either (A) is subsequently displayed on a screen or information service for a
Benchmark (including a Benchmark Replacement) or (B) is not, or is no longer, subject to an
announcement that it is not or will not be representative for a Benchmark (including a Benchmark
Replacement), then the Term Loan Administrative Agent may reinstate such previously removed
tenor for Benchmark (including Benchmark Replacement) settings.

                          (v)    Benchmark Unavailability Period. Upon the Lead Borrower’s
receipt of notice of the commencement of a Benchmark Unavailability Period with respect to a given
Benchmark, (i) the Lead Borrower may revoke any pending request for a Borrowing of, conversion
to or continuation of any affected Loans to be made, converted or continued during any Benchmark
Unavailability Period in accordance with to Section 2.26(a), and, failing that, (ii) the relevant request


      will be cancelled or converted or the affected Loans will be converted or prepaid in accordance with
      in accordance with to Section 2.26(a).

                                         ARTICLE III
                               REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES

        Each Borrower represents and warrants to the Term Lenders, the Term Loan Administrative Agent
and the Collateral Agent, in each case, to the extent and, unless otherwise specifically agreed by the Lead
Borrower, only on the dates required by Section 4.01 that:

         Section 3.01      Organization; Powers. The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member is
(a) duly organized, incorporated or registered, validly existing and (to the extent such concept exists in the
relevant jurisdiction) in good standing under the laws of the jurisdiction of its organization, incorporation
or registration, (b) has the corporate or other organizational power and authority, as applicable, to (i) carry
on its business as now conducted and (ii) execute, deliver and perform its obligations under each Loan
Document to which it is a party and (c) is qualified to do business, and is in good standing (to the extent
such concept exists in the relevant jurisdiction), in every jurisdiction where the conduct of its business
requires such qualification, except in the case of clause (a) above (other than with respect to the Lead
Borrower), clause (b) above (other than with respect to the Lead Borrower with respect to clause (b)(ii)
above) and clause (c) above, where the failure to do so would not, individually or in the aggregate,
reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect.

        Section 3.02       Authorization; Enforceability. This Agreement has been duly authorized, executed
and delivered by the Lead Borrower and the Canadian Borrower and constitutes, and each other Loan
Document to which any Loan Party is to be a party, when executed and delivered by such Loan Party, will
constitute, a legal, valid and binding obligation of the Lead Borrower, the Canadian Borrower or such Loan
Party, as the case may be, enforceable against it in accordance with its terms, subject to the Legal
Reservations.

        Section 3.03     Compliance with Laws. The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member is in
compliance with all material Requirements of Law (excluding Environmental Laws) applicable to it or its
property except where the failure to do so would not, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be
expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect, it being understood and agreed that this Section 3.03 shall
not apply to any law specifically referenced in Section 3.04(a).

        Section 3.04     Anti-Money Laundering, Sanctions and Anti-Corruption.

                  (a)       None of the Lead Borrower or any other Group Member or any of their respective
directors, officers or, to the knowledge of the Lead Borrower, employees, is a Sanctioned Person.

                 (b)     The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will not directly or, to its
knowledge, indirectly use or permit or authorize the use of the proceeds of the Loans for the purpose of
funding (i) any activities of or business with any Sanctioned Person or any activities or business in any
Sanctioned Country (except to the extent not prohibited by applicable Requirements of Law) or (ii) any
other transaction that would reasonably be expected to result in (A) a violation of Sanctions by the Lead
Borrower, any other Group Member or, to the knowledge of the Lead Borrower, any Term Lender or (B) the
designation of the Lead Borrower or any other Group Member or, to the knowledge of the Lead Borrower,
any Term Lender as a Sanctioned Person.

               (c)      The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will not directly or, to its
knowledge, indirectly use the proceeds of the Loans in violation of any Anti-Corruption Laws.


                 (d)     The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member is in compliance in all material
respects with all applicable Sanctions, Anti-Corruption Laws and Anti-Money Laundering Laws. As of the
Closing Date, none of the Lead Borrower, the other Group Members or, to the knowledge of the Lead
Borrower, any officer, director, employee or agent in connection with this Agreement is aware of any
