and BIF II, as applicable, and their combined consolidated Subsidiaries by furnishing (A) the applicable
financial statements of any other Parent Entity or (B) the Form 10-K or 10-Q (or the equivalent), as
applicable, of the Lead Borrower (or any other Parent Entity) and BIF II (or any other Parent Entity) filed
with the SEC or any securities exchange, in each case, within the time periods specified in such paragraphs,
which time periods shall be extended by the period of any extension permitted by the SEC and applicable
to any such filing, and without any requirement to provide notice of such filing to the Term Loan
Administrative Agent or to any Term Lender; provided that, with respect to each of clauses (A) and (B),
(i) if (1) such financial statements relate to any other Parent Entity and (2) either (I) such Parent Entity (or
any other Parent Entity that is a subsidiary of such Parent Entity) has any non-de-minimis third party
Indebtedness and/or non-de-minimis operations (in each case as determined by the Lead Borrower in good
faith and other than any operations that are attributable solely to such Parent Entity’s ownership of the
Borrowers and/or BIF II and their respective Subsidiaries) or (II) there are non-de-minimis differences
between the financial statements of such Parent Entity and its consolidated subsidiaries, on the one hand,
and the Lead Borrower and BIF II, as applicable, and their respective consolidated Subsidiaries, on the
other hand, such financial statements or the Form 10-K or Form 10-Q, as applicable, shall be accompanied
by consolidating information (which need not be audited) that summarizes in reasonable detail the
differences between the information relating to such Parent Entity, on the one hand, and the information
relating to the Lead Borrower and BIF II, as applicable, and their respective combined consolidated
Subsidiaries on a standalone basis, on the other hand, and (ii) to the extent such statements are in lieu of
statements required to be provided under Section 5.01(a) or Section 5.13, as applicable, such statements
shall be accompanied by a report of an independent accounting firm of nationally recognized standing or
another accounting firm reasonably acceptable to the Term Loan Administrative Agent, which report shall
satisfy the applicable requirements set forth in Section 5.01(a).

         Documents required to be delivered pursuant to this Section 5.01 may be delivered electronically
and, if so delivered, shall, unless the Lead Borrower otherwise elects, be deemed to have been delivered on
the earlier of the date (I) on which the Lead Borrower (or a representative thereof) posts such documents,
or provides a link thereto, on the Lead Borrower’s or any Affiliate’s website on the Internet, (II) on which
such documents are delivered by the Lead Borrower to the Term Loan Administrative Agent for posting on
the Lead Borrower’s behalf on IntraLinks/IntraAgency, SyndTrak or another secure website, if any, to
which each Term Lender and the Term Loan Administrative Agent has access (whether a commercial,
third-party website or whether sponsored by the Term Loan Administrative Agent) or (III) on which such
documents are faxed to the Term Loan Administrative Agent (or electronically mailed to an address
provided by the Term Loan Administrative Agent); provided that the Term Loan Administrative Agent
shall have no obligation to request the delivery of or maintain paper copies of the documents referred to
above, and each Term Lender shall be solely responsible for timely accessing posted documents and
maintaining its copies of such documents.


          Each Borrower hereby acknowledges that (1) the Term Loan Administrative Agent and/or Term
Loan Lead Arrangers will make available to the Term Lenders materials and/or information provided by or
on behalf of the Lead Borrower and/or BIF II, as applicable, hereunder (collectively, “Company Materials”)
by posting the Company Materials on IntraLinks, SyndTrak, ClearPar or another similar electronic system
(the “Platform”) and (2) certain of the Term Lenders (each, a “Public Lender”) may have personnel who
do not wish to receive material non-public information with respect to the Lead Borrower or its Affiliates,
or the respective securities of any of the foregoing, and who may be engaged in investment and other
market-related activities with respect to such Persons’ securities. Each Borrower hereby agrees that (w) it
will, upon the Term Loan Administrative Agent’s reasonable request, use commercially reasonable efforts
to conspicuously mark that portion of the Company Materials that may be distributed to the Public Lenders
as “PUBLIC” which, at a minimum, shall mean that the word “PUBLIC” shall appear prominently on the
first page thereof; (x) by marking Company Materials “PUBLIC,” the Lead Borrower shall be deemed to
have authorized the Term Loan Administrative Agent, the Term Loan Lead Arrangers and the Term Lenders
to treat such Company Materials as not containing any material non-public information (although it may be
sensitive and proprietary) with respect to the Lead Borrower or its respective Affiliates or Subsidiaries or
its or their respective securities for purposes of United States federal and state securities laws (provided,
however, that to the extent such Company Materials constitute Information, they shall be treated as set forth
in Section 9.12); (y) all Company Materials marked “PUBLIC” are permitted to be made available through
a portion of the Platform designated as “Public Side Information”; and (z) the Term Loan Administrative
Agent and the Term Loan Lead Arrangers shall treat any Company Materials that are not marked “PUBLIC”
as being suitable only for posting on a portion of the Platform not designated “Public Side Information”.
Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Lead Borrower shall be under no obligation to mark any Company
Materials or any document delivered pursuant to hereto as “PUBLIC”. Each Public Lender agrees to cause
at least one individual at or on behalf of such Public Lender to at all times have selected the “Private Side
Information” or similar designation on the content declaration screen of the Platform in order to enable such
Public Lender or its designee, in accordance with such Public Lender’s compliance procedures and
applicable law, including United States federal and state securities laws, to make reference to the
communications that are not made available through the “Public Side Information” portion of the Platform
and that may contain “Private Side Information”.

          Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Article V, none of the Lead Borrower or any other
Group Member will be required to disclose, permit the inspection, examination or making copies or
abstracts of, or discussion of, any document, information or other matter pursuant to this Article V that (i)
constitutes non-financial trade secrets or non-financial proprietary information, (ii) in respect of which
disclosure to the Term Loan Administrative Agent or any Term Lender (or their respective representatives
or contractors) is prohibited by Requirements of Law or any binding confidentiality agreement, (iii) is
subject to attorney-client or similar privilege or constitutes attorney work product or (iv) in respect of which
the Lead Borrower or any other Group Member owes confidentiality obligations to any third party; provided
that if the Lead Borrower or any Group Member does not provide information that is otherwise required to
be delivered pursuant to this Article V as a result of any of the foregoing exceptions, the Lead Borrower or
such Group Member, as applicable, shall use commercially reasonable efforts to (A) notify the Term Loan
Administrative Agent that such information is being withheld and (B) describe the applicable information
in reasonable detail, in each case with respect to the foregoing clauses (A) and (B), solely to the extent the
or such Group Member, as applicable, determines in good faith that such notification and description (x)
are feasible, (y) are permitted under Requirements of Law and such binding agreements and (z) would not
result in the waiver or deemed waiver of any such privilege, as applicable. For the avoidance of doubt,
anything disclosed, examined inspected or otherwise made available pursuant to this Article V shall be
subject to the provisions of Section 9.12 to the extent applicable.


       Section 5.02      Notices of Material Events. Promptly after any Responsible Officer of the Lead
Borrower obtains actual knowledge of any of the following, the Lead Borrower will furnish to the Term
Loan Administrative Agent (for distribution to each Term Lender through the Term Loan Administrative
Agent) written notice of the following:

                 (a)      the occurrence of any Default;

                (b)      the filing or commencement of any action, suit or proceeding by or before any
arbitrator or Governmental Authority against or, to the knowledge of a Financial Officer or another senior
executive officer of the Lead Borrower, affecting the Lead Borrower or any other Group Member, in each
case that would reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect; and

                (c)     the receipt of a written notice of an Environmental Liability or the occurrence of
an ERISA Event or Canadian Pension Event, in each case that would reasonably be expected to result in a
Material Adverse Effect. Each notice delivered under this Section 5.02(c) shall be accompanied by a written
statement of a Responsible Officer of the Lead Borrower setting forth details of the event or development
requiring such notice and any action taken or proposed to be taken with respect thereto.

          Section 5.03      Information Regarding Collateral.         The Lead Borrower will furnish to the
Term Loan Administrative Agent, within ninety (90) days (or earlier to the extent the Lead Borrower has
provided equivalent written notice to the ABL Agent, in which case the Lead Borrower shall provide
substantially contemporaneous notice to the Term Loan Administrative Agent) of the occurrence thereof or
such longer period as reasonably agreed to by the Term Loan Administrative Agent, written notice of any
change (i) in any Loan Party’s legal name (as set forth in its certificate of organization or like document)
or (ii) in the jurisdiction of incorporation or organization or the location of the chief executive office of any
Loan Party or in the form of its organization, in each case to the extent such information is necessary to
enable the Collateral Agent to perfect or maintain the perfection or priority of its security interest in the
Collateral of the relevant Loan Party.

         Section 5.04     Preservation of Existence. The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will
do or cause to be done all things necessary to obtain, preserve, renew and keep in full force and effect its
(a) legal existence and (b) the rights, licenses, permits, privileges, and franchises necessary and material to
its business (including all Natural Gas Storage Facilities and applicable pipelines), in each case (other than
clause (a) above with respect to the Lead Borrower) to the extent that the failure to do so would reasonably
be expected, individually or in the aggregate, to result in a Material Adverse Effect; provided that the
foregoing shall not prohibit any merger, amalgamation, consolidation, disposition, liquidation, dissolution,
or any other action permitted by Section 6.03, Section 6.04, Section 6.05, and Section 6.08 (including in
connection with any Permitted Reorganization, IPO Reorganization Transaction or Tax Restructuring).

         Section 5.05     Payment of Taxes, Etc. The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will
pay its obligations in respect of material Taxes before such obligations shall become delinquent or in
default, except (a) where the failure to make payment would not reasonably be expected, individually or in
the aggregate, to result in a Material Adverse Effect, (b) Taxes that are not overdue by more than 60 days
or (c) Taxes that are being contested in good faith by appropriate proceedings for which adequate reserves
have been made in accordance with the Applicable Accounting Principles.

         Section 5.06   Maintenance of Properties. The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will
keep and maintain all tangible property necessary and material to its business in reasonably good working
order and condition, ordinary wear and tear and casualty and condemnation excepted, except where the
failure to do so would not reasonably be expected, individually or in the aggregate, to have a Material
Adverse Effect. In the event of the Release of any Hazardous Material on any real property of the Lead


Borrower or any other Group Member which is in violation in any material respect of Environmental Laws,
the Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will (i) take, reasonably promptly after discovery thereof
and solely to the extent required under applicable Environmental Laws, all reasonable and necessary steps
to perform any response, corrective and other action to mitigate or eliminate any such violation and (ii) keep
the Term Loan Administrative Agent reasonably informed of their actions and the results of such actions
as the Term Loan Administrative Agent shall reasonably request (provided that failure to do so shall not
constitute a Default hereunder), except in the case of each of clauses (i) and (ii) where the failure to do so
would not reasonably be expected, individually or in the aggregate, to result in a Material Adverse Effect;
provided that no Group Member shall be required to undertake any such response, corrective or other action
to the extent that its obligation to do so is being contested in good faith and by proper proceedings and
appropriate reserves are being maintained with respect to such circumstances in accordance with the
Applicable Accounting Principles.

         Section 5.07     Insurance. Except where the failure to do so would not reasonably be expected to
have a Material Adverse Effect, the Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will maintain (or cause
to be maintained), with insurance companies that the Lead Borrower or such other Group Member believes
(in the good faith judgment of the management of the Lead Borrower or such other Group Member) are
financially sound and responsible at the time the relevant coverage is placed or renewed, insurance in at
least such amounts (after giving effect to any self-insurance which the Lead Borrower or such other Group
Member believes (in the good faith judgment of management of the Lead Borrower or such other Group
Member) is reasonable and prudent in light of the size and nature of its business) and against at least such
risks (and with such risk retentions) as the Lead Borrower or such other Group Member believes (in the
good faith judgment of the management of the Lead Borrower or such other Group Member) are reasonable
and prudent in light of the size and nature of its business, and will furnish to the Term Lenders, upon written
request from the Term Loan Administrative Agent, information presented in reasonable detail as to the
insurance so carried. Subject to Section 5.13 and each applicable Intercreditor Agreement, each such policy
of insurance maintained by a Loan Party shall, to the extent covering Collateral (excluding any business
interruption insurance, workers’ compensation policy or employee liability policy) and to the extent the
Collateral Agent can be granted an insurable interest therein (or can be named as additional insured or loss
payee/mortgagee, as applicable, thereunder) and to the extent available from the relevant insurer after the
Lead Borrower’s use of commercially reasonable efforts, (i) in the case of each liability insurance policy,
name the Collateral Agent, on behalf of the Secured Parties, as an additional insured thereunder as its
interests may appear and (ii) in the case of each property insurance policy, contain a loss payable/mortgagee
clause (including an applicable standard hypothecary clause, as developed by the Insurance Bureau of
Canada) or endorsement that names the Collateral Agent, on behalf of the Secured Parties, as the loss
payee/mortgagee thereunder; provided that (A) there shall be no requirement to provide prior written notice
to the Collateral Agent of any modification or cancellation of any policies in this Section 5.07 and (B) unless
an Event of Default is continuing, (1) the Term Loan Administrative Agent shall turn over to the applicable
Group Member any amount received by it as an additional insured or loss payee under any property
insurance maintained by the Lead Borrower, BIF II and their respective Subsidiaries, (2) the Term Loan
Administrative Agent agrees that the Lead Borrower, BIF II and/or the applicable Restricted Subsidiary
shall have the sole right to adjust or settle any claims under such insurance, and (3) all proceeds from a
casualty event shall be paid to the Lead Borrower or applicable Group Member.

         Section 5.08     Books and Records; Inspection and Audit Rights. The Lead Borrower and each
other Group Member will maintain proper books of record and account in which entries that are full, true
and correct in all material respects shall be made of all material financial transactions and matters involving
the assets and business of the Lead Borrower or the Group Members, as the case may be, in order to permit
the preparation of combined consolidated financial statements in all material respects in conformity with
the Applicable Accounting Principles (or applicable local standards). Subject in all respects to the last
paragraph in Section 5.01, of the Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will permit any


representatives designated by the Term Loan Administrative Agent, upon reasonable prior notice and in
compliance with applicable Requirements of Law, to visit and inspect its properties at which the principal
financial records and executive officers of the applicable Person are located, to examine and make extracts
from its and their respective books and records, and to discuss its and their respective affairs, finances and
condition with its Responsible Officers and independent public accountants (subject to such accountants’
customary policies and procedures) (provided that the Lead Borrower and/or BIF II (or any of their
respective Subsidiaries) may, if it so chooses, have one or more employees or representatives be present at
or participate in any such discussion), all upon reasonable notice and at such reasonable times during normal
business hours; provided that, (x) only the Term Loan Administrative Agent on behalf of the Term Lenders
may exercise the visitation and inspection rights of the Term Loan Administrative Agent and the Term
Lenders under this Section 5.08 and (y) the Term Loan Administrative Agent shall not exercise such rights
more often than one time during any calendar year absent the existence of an Event of Default, which
visitation and inspection shall be at the reasonable expense of the Lead Borrower; provided, further, that
when an Event of Default exists and is continuing, the Term Loan Administrative Agent (or any of its
representatives or independent contractors) may do any of the foregoing at the expense of the Lead
Borrower at any time during normal business hours and upon reasonable advance notice; provided, further,
that consolidated, combined, aggregated, affiliated, unitary or similar Tax returns that include any Person
that is not a Loan Party shall not be subject to the foregoing requirement.

        Section 5.09     Compliance with Laws.

                  (a)     The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will comply with Requirements
of Law (including Environmental Laws, ERISA and Canadian Pension Legislation) applicable to it and its
property, except, in each case, to the extent failure of the Lead Borrower or the relevant Group Member to
comply would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect; provided that, with respect to
Anti-Corruption Laws, Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Laws, the Lead Borrower and each other
Group Member will comply in all material respects; and provided further that the requirements set forth in
this Section 5.09, as they pertain to compliance by any Foreign Subsidiary with Sanctions are subject to,
and limited by, any Requirement of Law applicable to such Foreign Subsidiary in its relevant local
jurisdiction, including but not limited to the Foreign Extraterritorial Measures (United States) Order, 1992
(Canada) or any similar anti-boycott or blocking law, regulation or statute.

                   (b)    The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will not, and will not authorize
any of their respective directors, officers, agents, employees and representatives to, directly or to its
knowledge, indirectly, use any part of the proceeds of the Loans, or otherwise make available such proceeds,
directly or, to its knowledge, indirectly, (i) for the purpose of financing any activities or business with any
Person that, at the time of such financing, is a Sanctioned Person (except to the extent not prohibited by
applicable Requirements of Law) or (ii) in any other manner that would (x) constitute or give rise to a
violation of Sanctions by, or (y) reasonably be expected to result in the designation as a Sanctioned Person
of the Lead Borrower, any other Group Member or, to the knowledge of the Lead Borrower, any Term
Lender.

                   (c)    The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will not, and will not authorize
any of their respective directors, officers, employees, agents and representatives to, directly or, to its
knowledge, indirectly, use any part of the proceeds of the Loans, or otherwise make available such proceeds,
directly or, to its knowledge, indirectly, in a manner that would result in the violation by the Lead Borrower
or any other Group Member or, to the knowledge of the Lead Borrower, any Term Lender, of any Anti-
Corruption Laws or Anti-Money Laundering Laws.

                (d)     The applicable Group Members will maintain in effect policies and procedures
reasonably designed to promote compliance by the Lead Borrower and each applicable Group Member and


their respective directors, officers, employees and agents with Sanctions, Anti-Corruption Laws and Anti-
Money Laundering Laws, in each case, applicable to them and their property.

         The covenants set forth in this Section 5.09 by or with respect to any Foreign Subsidiary shall not
be given to or by any person if and to the extent that the obligations under this Section 5.09 would be
unenforceable to be given by or in respect of that person by reason of breach of, or would result in a breach
by that person or conflict with any Requirements of Law applicable to such person, including by not limited
to the Foreign Extraterritorial Measures (United States) Order, 1992 (Canada) or any similar anti-boycott
or blocking law, regulation or statute.

                  (a)      The proceeds of the Initial Term Loans made on the Closing Date shall be utilized
(i) to finance all or a portion of the Transactions (including the payment of Transaction Costs) and (ii) for
general corporate purposes.

                 (b)     [Reserved].

                 (c)     [Reserved].

                 (d)     [Reserved].

                 (e)     [Reserved].

                 (f)      The proceeds of any Incremental Term Loans shall be utilized for the purposes set
forth in the applicable Incremental Facility Amendment.

                (g)      The proceeds of any Other Term Loans shall be utilized for the purposes set forth
in Section 2.21(a).

        Section 5.11     Additional Subsidiaries; Further Assurances.

                  (a)       If any additional Group Member is formed or acquired after the Closing Date,
unless such Subsidiary is an Excluded Subsidiary, the applicable Borrower(s) will, on or prior to the later
of (i) the date that is 90 days after such formation or acquisition, (ii) the date on which financial statements
are required to be delivered pursuant to Section 5.01(a) for the fiscal quarter in which such formation or
acquisition occurs and (iii) such later date as the Term Loan Administrative Agent shall reasonably agree,
take (or cause to be taken) all actions (if any) required to be taken with respect to such newly formed or
acquired Group Member in order to satisfy the Collateral and Guarantee Requirement with respect to such
Group Member; provided that (x) any designation of an Unrestricted Subsidiary as a Restricted Subsidiary
(that is not otherwise an Excluded Subsidiary) or any Restricted Subsidiary ceasing to be an Excluded
Subsidiary shall constitute the formation or acquisition of a Restricted Subsidiary for purposes of this
Section 5.11 and (y) the parties hereto acknowledge that a Group Member may be an Excluded Subsidiary
with respect to one Class of Loans and not with respect to other Classes of Loans, in which case the
requirements of this Section 5.11 and the Collateral and Guarantee Requirement shall only apply with
respect to the applicable Loans. Notwithstanding the foregoing, if any new Restricted Subsidiary is created
solely for the purpose of consummating an acquisition or other Investment permitted by Section 6.04, and
such new Restricted Subsidiary at no time holds any material assets or liabilities other than any acquisition
or Investment consideration contributed to it contemporaneously with the closing of such transaction, such
new Restricted Subsidiary shall not be required to take the actions set forth in this Section 5.11 until the


respective acquisition or other Investment is consummated (at which time the surviving entity of the
respective transaction shall be required to so comply in accordance with the provisions thereof).

                (b)     Subject to the provisions of the last paragraph of this Section 5.11 and the
exceptions and limitations set forth herein and in the other Loan Documents, the Lead Borrower and each
other Loan Party will execute (if applicable) any and all further documents, financing statements,
agreements and instruments, and take all such further actions (including the filing and recording of
financing statements, fixture filings, mortgages, deeds of trust and other documents), that (i) may be
required under any applicable Requirements of Law and (ii) the Term Loan Administrative Agent or the
Required Lenders reasonably request in order to ensure the creation, perfection and priority of the Liens
created or intended to be created under the Security Documents, all at the expense of the relevant Loan
Parties.

Notwithstanding the foregoing provisions of this Section 5.11 or the definition of “Collateral and Guarantee
Requirement” or anything in this Agreement or any other Loan Document to the contrary:

                  (c)      the Collateral and Guarantee Requirement and the foregoing provisions of this
Section 5.11 shall not require the creation or perfection of pledges of or security interests in, or the obtaining
of title insurance, legal opinions or other deliverables with respect to, particular assets of the Loan Parties,
or the provision of Guarantees by any Subsidiary:

                                (i)      if such assets constitute Excluded Assets;

                                 (ii)     if, and for so long as and to the extent that the Lead Borrower in
      good faith determines that the cost, burden or consequence of creating or perfecting such pledges or
      security interests in such assets, or obtaining such title insurance, legal opinions or other deliverables
      in respect of such assets, or providing such Guarantees (taking into account any non-de minimis
      adverse Tax consequences (including the imposition of non-de minimis withholding or Other Taxes)
      and any non-de minimis adverse regulatory consequences, in each case to the Lead Borrower or its
      Subsidiaries or any Parent Entities, Affiliates or direct or indirect equity owners thereof), outweighs
      (or is excessive in light of) the benefits to be obtained by the Term Lenders therefrom as determined
      by the Lead Borrower in good faith (it being understood that, in any event, the Collateral Agent shall
      have the right to waive or modify any requirements relating to title insurance, legal opinions or other
      deliverables with respect to any assets if, in its reasonable determination, the cost, burden or
      consequence of obtaining such deliverables is excessive in relation to their benefit to the Term
      Lenders); and/or

                                 (iii)    if the grant or perfection of a security interest in such asset would
      (A) be prohibited by enforceable provisions of any applicable Requirement of Law, (B) violate the
      terms of any contract (to the extent binding on such property at the time of the acquisition thereof
      and not incurred in contemplation of such acquisition) (in each case, after giving effect to the
      applicable anti-assignment provisions of the UCC, PPSA or other applicable Requirement of Law)
      or (C) trigger termination of any contract pursuant to any “change of control” or “change in control”
      or similar provision (to the extent binding on such property at the time of the acquisition thereof and
      not incurred in contemplation of such acquisition); it being understood that the Collateral shall
      include any proceeds and/or receivables (other than to the extent constituting Excluded Assets)
      arising out of any contract described in this clause (iii) to the extent the assignment of such proceeds
      or receivables is expressly deemed effective under the UCC, PPSA or other applicable Requirement
      of Law notwithstanding the relevant prohibition, violation or termination right (and any such asset
      subject to this clause (iii) shall be an “Excluded Asset” for purposes of this Agreement and all other
      Loan Documents);


              (d)     Liens required to be granted from time to time pursuant to the term “Collateral and
Guarantee Requirement” shall be subject to the exceptions and limitations set forth herein and in the
Security Documents and shall be subject to accommodations in respect of any COVID-19 Measures then
in effect;

                  (e)     (i) no third-party control agreements or other third-party control or similar
arrangements shall be required with respect to deposit accounts, securities accounts, commodities accounts
or other assets specifically requiring perfection by third party control agreements (other than accounts for
which control agreements are obtained under the ABL Documents and for which the ABL Agent acts as
gratuitous bailee in accordance with the terms of the Initial Intercreditor Agreement, on behalf of the Term
Loan Administrative Agent) and (ii) in no event shall entry into any source code escrow arrangements or
the registration of any Intellectual Property be required;

                 (f)     no perfection actions shall be required, nor shall the Term Loan Administrative
Agent or Collateral Agent be authorized to take any perfection or other actions, other than (i) filings
pursuant to the UCC in the office of the secretary of state (or similar central filing office) of the relevant
state(s) or the PPSA (or equivalent filing under the laws of the Province of Québec) in the registry of the
relevant provinces(s) and territories of Canada or the granting and registration of security under the Bank
Act (Canada), (ii) filings of Intellectual Property Security Agreements with the United States Patent and
Trademark Office, the United States Copyright Office or the Canadian Intellectual Property Office, in each
case, with respect to Intellectual Property constituting Collateral, and (iii) subject to the Intercreditor
Agreements, delivery to the Collateral Agent to be held in its possession of all Collateral consisting of
certificated Equity Interests and instruments, in each case to the extent not constituting Excluded Assets
and to the extent required to be delivered pursuant to the applicable Security Documents;

                 (g)     no actions in any jurisdiction other than an Applicable Security Jurisdiction, or
required by the laws of any jurisdiction other than an Applicable Security Jurisdiction, shall be required to
be taken, nor shall the Term Loan Administrative Agent or the Collateral Agent be authorized to take any
such action, to create any security interests in assets located or titled outside of an Applicable Security
Jurisdiction (including any Equity Interests of Subsidiaries organized under the laws of a jurisdiction other
than an Applicable Security Jurisdiction and any Excluded Foreign Intellectual Property) or to perfect or
make enforceable any security interests in any such assets (it being understood that there shall be no security
agreements or pledge agreements governed under the laws of any jurisdiction other than an Applicable
Security Jurisdiction and all guarantee agreements shall be governed under the laws of the State of New
York (other than the Canadian Guarantee Agreement)); and

                (h)    no Loan Party shall be required to seek any landlord lien waiver, estoppel,
warehouseman waiver or other collateral access or similar letter or agreement (other than, for the avoidance
of doubt, the Acknowledgement Agreements as set forth in Section 5.13); and

                 (i)      (1) the Term Loan Administrative Agent (in its reasonable discretion) may grant
extensions of time (including after the expiration of any relevant period, which extensions shall apply
retroactively) and (2) relevant time periods shall be automatically extended during which any applicable
Loan Party is unable, after exercising commercially reasonable efforts, to perform its obligations due to
circumstances existing in connection with COVID-19 Measures then in effect, in each case, for the creation
and perfection of security interests in or the obtaining of other deliverables with respect to particular assets
or the provision of any Guarantee by the Lead Borrower, BIF II or any Restricted Subsidiary (including
extensions beyond the Closing Date, the timelines set forth in this Section 5.11 or Section 5.13 or in the
Security Documents or in connection with assets acquired, or Subsidiaries formed or acquired, after the
Closing Date) and, in each case of the foregoing, each Term Lender hereby consents to any such extension
of time.


        Section 5.12    Ratings. The Lead Borrower will use commercially reasonable efforts (a) to
continuously have a public corporate credit rating from S&P and a public corporate family rating from
Moody’s (but not to maintain a specific rating level) and (b) to cause the Initial Term Facility to be
continuously rated by each of S&P and Moody’s (but not to maintain a specific rating level).

        Section 5.13     Certain Post-Closing Obligations.

                  (a)      On or prior to the applicable date set forth on Schedule 5.13(a) or such later date
as the Term Loan Administrative Agent reasonably agrees, the Lead Borrower shall deliver or cause to be
delivered the documents or take the actions specified on Schedule 5.13, in each case except to the extent
otherwise agreed by the Term Loan Administrative Agent; provided that the foregoing shall, in all cases,
be subject to the limitations set forth in the last paragraph of Section 5.11 and on Schedule 5.13 or otherwise
set forth in the applicable Loan Documents.

                  (b)     Promptly following the Closing Date, the Borrowers shall use commercially
reasonable efforts to file for and obtain the necessary regulatory approvals from the CPUC (1) approving
the Guarantees provided by the CPUC Parties under the US Guarantee Agreement, (2) authorizing the
CPUC Parties to grant security interests in all of their PUC Collateral, in favor of the Collateral Agent, for
the benefit of the Secured Parties, (3) authorizing Lodi Gas Storage, L.L.C. to become an Additional
Borrower and (4) authorizing any additional actions that require CPUC Approval, in each case with respect
to the Initial Term Facility as in effect on the Closing Date.

               (c)     Promptly following the Closing Date, and in any event no later than forty-five (45)
days following the Closing Date, the Borrowers shall use commercially reasonable efforts to cause the
Acknowledgement Agreements to be executed and delivered (including, for certainty, by the counterparties
to the Acknowledgement Agreements).

                (d)      Promptly following the Closing Date, but in no event later than sixty (60) days
after the Closing Date, the Borrowers shall submit for registration any and all of the Unregistered Fixed
Liens (which, for certainty, the Administrative Agent may request at any time in its sole discretion) in order
to cause such Unregistered Fixed Liens to become Registered Fixed Liens.

                  (e)     This Section 5.13 shall be deemed to qualify the representations, warranties,
covenants and other agreements in the Loan Documents such that no inaccuracy or breach thereof shall
arise in respect of the matters set forth on Schedule 5.13 prior to the time by which such actions are required
to be taken.

         Section 5.14     Designation of Subsidiaries. The Lead Borrower may at any time after the Closing
Date designate (or subsequently re-designate) any Restricted Subsidiary as an Unrestricted Subsidiary or
any Unrestricted Subsidiary as a Restricted Subsidiary; provided that (a) immediately before and after
giving effect to such designation on a Pro Forma Basis, no Specified Event of Default shall have occurred
and be continuing, and (b) no Subsidiary shall be designated as an Unrestricted Subsidiary if (i) such
Subsidiary owns Material Intellectual Property at the time of such designation and (ii) such Material
Intellectual Property is, following such designation, licensed by any Group Member from the recipient of
such Material Intellectual Property for use by such Group Member in the ordinary course of business (other
than pursuant to a bona fide “transition service” or similar arrangement or in the same manner as other
customers, suppliers or commercial partners of the relevant transferee generally). The designation of any
Restricted Subsidiary as an Unrestricted Subsidiary after the Closing Date shall constitute an Investment
by each relevant Group Member therein at the date of designation in an amount equal to the Fair Market
Value of the net assets of such Subsidiary attributable to each relevant Group Member’s equity Investment
therein as determined by the Lead Borrower in good faith; provided that if any subsidiary (a “Subject


Subsidiary”) being designated as an Unrestricted Subsidiary has a subsidiary that was previously designated
as an Unrestricted Subsidiary (the “Previously Designated Unrestricted Subsidiary”) in compliance with
the provisions of this Agreement, the Investment of such Subject Subsidiary in such Previously Designated
Unrestricted Subsidiary shall not be taken into account, and shall be excluded, in determining whether the
Subject Subsidiary may be designated as an Unrestricted Subsidiary hereunder. The designation of any
Unrestricted Subsidiary as a Restricted Subsidiary shall constitute (i) the incurrence at the time of
designation of any Indebtedness or Liens of such Subsidiary existing at such time (as applicable), (ii) a
return on any Investment by each relevant Group Member in Unrestricted Subsidiaries pursuant to the
preceding sentence in an amount equal to the Fair Market Value as of the date of such designation of the
net assets of such Subsidiary attributable to each relevant Group Member’s equity Investment in such
Subsidiary as determined by the Lead Borrower in good faith and (iii) the formation or acquisition of a
Group Member for purposes of Section 5.11.

         Section 5.15   Change in Nature of Business. The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member
will engage only in material lines of business substantially the same as those lines of business consisting of
(a) the businesses engaged (or proposed to be engaged) in by the Lead Borrower and the other Group
Members on the Closing Date, (b) any Similar Business and/or (c) any other line of business to which the
Term Loan Administrative Agent may consent.

         Section 5.16     Accounting Changes. Each Group Member will maintain its fiscal year as in effect
on the Closing Date; provided, however, that (a) the Lead Borrower may, upon written notice to the Term
Loan Administrative Agent, change its fiscal year end to another date and (b) any Group Member may
change its fiscal year to the same fiscal year as the Lead Borrower, then, in each such case of clauses (a)
and (b), the Lead Borrower and the Term Loan Administrative Agent will, and are hereby authorized by
the Term Lenders to (without requiring the consent of any other Person, including any Term Lender), make
any adjustments to this Agreement that are necessary to reflect such change in fiscal year, including a
deferral of the first Excess Cash Flow prepayment date following such change to the applicable date with
respect to such new fiscal year end.

         Section 5.17    Lender Calls. The Borrower shall, quarterly upon the request of the Term Loan
Administrative Agent at a time mutually agreed with the Term Loan Administrative Agent that is promptly
after the delivery of financial statements pursuant to Section 5.01(a) and Section 5.01(b), as applicable,
participate in a conference call with Term Lenders (which, at the election of the Lead Borrower, may be
held jointly with any such conference call organized with respect to any other Indebtedness of the Group
Members) to discuss the financial condition and results of operations of the Lead Borrower and the other
Group Members for the fiscal period covered thereby; provided, that such participation shall no longer be
required following the consummation of an IPO.

       Section 6.02     Liens. The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will not create, incur,
assume or permit to exist any Lien upon any property or asset of the Lead Borrower or any other Group
Member, whether now owned or hereafter acquired, in each case, that secures Indebtedness, other than any:

                (a)     Liens created under (i) the Loan Documents, including Liens securing Incremental
Term Facilities as provided for herein and (ii) the ABL Documents (including, in each case, Permitted
Refinancings or replacements thereof); provided that, the Liens pursuant to the ABL Documents (or any
Permitted Refinancing or replacements thereof) shall be subject to the Initial Intercreditor Agreement or an
Acceptable Intercreditor Agreement of the type described in clause (a) of the definition thereof.

                 (b)     Permitted Encumbrances;

renewals or extensions thereof and, without duplication, Liens in respect of any Permitted Refinancing of
any Indebtedness secured thereby;

6.01(a)(xxxviii); provided that (i) (A) other than with respect to Capital Lease Obligations, such Liens do
not at any time encumber any property other than the property acquired, developed, purchased, leased,
constructed, repaired, restored, replaced, maintained, upgraded, expanded or improved with the proceeds
of such Indebtedness and accessions and additions to such property, replacements or improvements thereof,
customary security deposits with respect thereto, related contract rights and payment intangibles, and the

         Section 6.03     Fundamental Changes. The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will not
merge into or consolidate or amalgamate with any other Person, or permit any Person to merge into or
consolidate with it, or liquidate or dissolve, or Dispose of (whether in one transaction or in a series of
transactions) all or substantially all of the assets (whether now owned or hereafter acquired) of the Lead
Borrower and the other Group Members, taken as a whole, to or in favor of any Person (other than as part
of the Transactions), except that:

               (a)     any Group Member may merge, amalgamate or consolidate with or into the Lead
Borrower or any other Group Member; provided that

                                (i)     in the case of any such merger, amalgamation or consolidation with
      or into a Borrower:

                                  (A)     a Borrower shall be the continuing or surviving Person or

                                  (B)     if the Person formed by, continuing following, or surviving any
such merger, amalgamation or consolidation (including any immediate and successive mergers,
consolidations or amalgamations of entities) is not such Borrower (any such Person after giving effect to
such transaction or transactions, the “Successor Borrower”), (x) the Successor Borrower shall be an entity
organized or existing under the laws of a Permitted Jurisdiction, (y) the Successor Borrower shall expressly
assume all the obligations of such Borrower under this Agreement and the other Loan Documents to which
such Borrower is a party pursuant to a written agreement in form and substance reasonably satisfactory to
the Term Loan Administrative Agent and (z) except as the Term Loan Administrative Agent may otherwise
agree, each Loan Party other than such Borrower, unless it is the other party to such merger, amalgamation
or consolidation, shall have reaffirmed in writing that its Guarantee of, and grant of any Liens as security
for, the Secured Obligations shall apply to the Successor Borrower’s obligations under this Agreement and
the other Loan Documents to which such Successor Borrower is a party; it being understood and agreed
that if the foregoing conditions under clauses (x) through (z) are satisfied, the Successor Borrower will
succeed to, and be substituted for, the Lead Borrower under this Agreement and the other Loan Documents
to which the Lead Borrower is a party; provided, that (x) the applicable Borrower shall have delivered to
the Term Loan Administrative Agent a certificate of a Responsible Officer stating that such merger,
amalgamation or consolidation complies with this Agreement and (y) no Specified Event of Default exists
immediately before or after giving effect to such merger, amalgamation or consolidation; provided, further,
that the Lead Borrower agrees to provide any documentation and other information about the Successor
Borrower at least three Business Days prior to the consummation of any such merger, amalgamation or
consolidation as shall have been reasonably requested in writing by any Term Lender through the Term


Loan Administrative Agent at least ten Business Days prior to the consummation of such merger,
amalgamation or consolidation that such Term Lender shall have reasonably determined is required by
regulatory authorities under applicable “know your customer” and Anti-Money Laundering Laws,
including Title III of the USA Patriot Act and the Canadian AML Act and

                                  (ii)   in the case of any such merger, amalgamation or consolidation with
        or into any Loan Party, either (x) a Loan Party shall be the continuing or surviving Person or the
        continuing or surviving Person or the Person formed as a result of the relevant transaction, as
        applicable, shall expressly assume the guarantee obligations of the Loan Party in a manner reasonably
        satisfactory to the Term Loan Administrative Agent or (y) the relevant transaction shall be treated as
        an Investment and otherwise be made in compliance with Section 6.04;

               (b)     the Lead Borrower and/or any Group Member may enter into and/or consummate
any Permitted Reorganization, any IPO Reorganization Transaction or any Tax Restructuring;

                (c)     any Group Member may liquidate or dissolve (including the initiation of any
insolvency or similar proceeding that does not result in an Event of Default under Section 7.01(i)) if the
Lead Borrower determines in good faith that such action is in the best interests of the Lead Borrower and
the other Group Members, taken as a whole, and is not materially disadvantageous to the Term Lenders;

                (d)     any Group Member may make a Disposition of all or substantially all of its assets
(upon voluntary liquidation or otherwise) to the Lead Borrower or any other Group Member;

                (e)     any Group Member may form a Delaware Divided LLC and any Group Member
that is a Delaware Divided LLC may liquidate or dissolve provided that, in each case, the Lead Borrower
complies with Section 5.11 with respect to such Delaware Divided LLC to the extent applicable;

                 (f)      any Group Member (subject to the proviso to clause (a) above in the case of the
Lead Borrower) may be transferred to or acquired by, or merge, consolidate or amalgamate with, any other
Person, or dissolve or liquidate, solely in order to effect a Disposition not prohibited by Section 6.05 (other
than Section 6.05(f)) or a Restricted Payment not prohibited by Section 6.08 (other than Section 6.08(a)(ii)),
together with any related transaction not prohibited hereunder;

Lead Borrower) may merge, consolidate or amalgamate with any other Person solely in order to effect a
Permitted Acquisition or other Investment not prohibited by Section 6.04 (other than Section 6.04(t)),
together with any related transaction not prohibited hereunder; and

6.04.

       Section 6.04   Investments, Loans, Advances, Guarantees and Acquisitions. The Lead Borrower
and each other Group Member will not make any Investment, except:

                (a)     Investments in cash and Cash Equivalents or Investment Grade Securities at the
time such Investment is made;

               (b)      loans, advances and other credit extensions to Permitted Payees (i) for reasonable
and customary business-related travel, entertainment, relocation (including moving expenses and costs of
replacement homes), drawing accounts, business machines or supplies, automobiles and analogous ordinary
business expenditures, (ii) in connection with such Person’s purchase of Equity Interests in any Parent


Entity and (iii) for purposes not described in the foregoing clauses (i) and (ii); provided that in the case of
this clause (iii) that either (x) no cash or Cash Equivalents are advanced in connection with such loan,

(y) of this proviso shall not exceed the greater of $25,250,000 and 10% of Consolidated EBITDA for the
most recently ended Test Period;

will, upon such Investment, become a Group Member);

                (g)      Investments arising under or in connection with Swap Agreements not prohibited
under Section 6.01;

         Section 6.05     Asset Sales. The Lead Borrower and each other Group Member will not (i) sell,
transfer, lease or otherwise dispose of any asset (each, a “Disposition”), including any Equity Interest
owned by it or (ii) issue any additional Equity Interest in such other Group Member (other than (A) issuing
or otherwise Disposing of directors’ or officers’ qualifying shares or shares issued to foreign nationals to
the extent required by applicable Requirements of Law, (B) issuing Equity Interests to the Parent Affiliates
(or any other Parent Entity) or any Group Member in compliance with Section 6.04 and (C) any non-wholly-
owned Group Member issuing Equity Interests to each owner of its Equity Interests ratably based on their
relative ownership interests), in each case, outside of the ordinary course of business and having a Fair
Market Value in excess of (x) with respect to any single transaction or series of related transactions, the
greater of (I) $50,500,000 and (II) 20% of Consolidated EBITDA for the most recently ended Test Period
or (y) with respect to all other Dispositions in any fiscal year not excluded pursuant to subclause (x), the
greater of (I) $75,750,000 and (II) 30% of Consolidated EBITDA for the most recently ended Test Period,
for all such other transactions on an aggregate basis in any fiscal year (provided that any unused amount
pursuant to this clause (y) during any fiscal year may be carried forward into the succeeding years until
applied), except:

                 (a)     Dispositions described on Schedule 6.05 hereto;

                 (b)     Dispositions of surplus, obsolete, used or worn out property or other property, in
each case whether now owned or hereafter acquired, if made in the good faith determination of the Lead
Borrower or the applicable Group Member and/or in the ordinary course of business or consistent with past
or industry practice and Dispositions of property (including software or other rights in Intellectual Property)
no longer used or useful to, or economically practicable or commercially reasonable to maintain, and
Dispositions of Intellectual Property that is not material to, or is no longer used in, the business of the Lead
Borrower or the other Group Members (including (i) allowing any registration or application for registration
of any such Intellectual Property to expire, lapse, go abandoned or be invalidated or (ii) disposing of,
discontinuing the use or maintenance of, abandoning, failing to pursue or otherwise allowing to lapse,
expire, terminate or put into the public domain any such Intellectual Property, in each case, if the Lead
Borrower determines in its reasonable business judgment that any of the foregoing does not materially
interfere with or materially impair the business of the Lead Borrower and the other Group Members, taken
as a whole);

                   (c)    (i) Dispositions or consignments of inventory, goods held for sale, equipment or
other assets (including leasehold or licensed interests in real property), including on an intercompany basis
(x) in the ordinary course of business or consistent with past or industry practice or (y) with respect to
facilities that are temporarily not in use, held for sale or closed or the discontinuation of any product line
or line of business, (ii) the leasing or subleasing of real property in the ordinary course of business or
consistent with past or industry practice and (iii) to the extent constituting a Disposition, the expiration of
any option or similar agreement in respect of real or personal property;

                (d)     Dispositions of property to the extent that (i) such property is exchanged for credit
against the purchase price of similar replacement property, or other assets or services of comparable or


greater value or usefulness to the business (including transactions covered by Section 1031 of the Code or

(ii) an amount equal to the Net Proceeds of such Disposition are promptly applied to the purchase price of
